1040: Im divshi shatiti yini im chalavi kullehon itshakyayn vitrauu mimmabbua denachala.

Ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim, kol innun diltatta. vechullehu anfin (nusach acher almin) kullehu, itberachu vittezanu, kad illen itberachu leella. uvemma mitbarchan umitbasseman, kullehu berecha dekarbena.

Ta chazi, beshaata denachtat keneset yisrael leashraha diyyuraha beara, kudesha berich hu amar la, lehay kera, begin deishtechachu birchan vechedv bechullehu almin, vitbassemat hi, lenafka minnah birchan lecholla. dechad illen shit itbarchan, keden kullehu almin itbarchan kachada letatta, umitbarchan leella. (sefer acher ucheneset yisrael veyisrael) itberachu mekullehu. davar acher bati leganni achoti challa. ribbi yitzchak amar, la izdavvga kudesha berich hu (sefer acher yisrael) bikkenset yisrael, ella bezimna deillen shit atrevavn, mishshakyu denachala dela pasak.
1041: Bekudesha berich hu beara. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash vshachanti betocham, ucheden illae vetattae itbessamu.

(Vayikra 1:1) vayyikra el moshe. rabbi shimon patach, (Shir HaShirim 2:12) hannitztzanim niru vaaretz et hazzamir higgia vekol hattor nishma beartzenu. hay kera it beh leistakkela, kevan dichtiv niru vaartz, mahu dichtiv nishma beartzenu, deha bechad aretz sagya. ella hannitztzanim, illen innun netian deakaran kudesha berich hu veshatil lon beatra ochora, veitreviu, kintiata kad appik parchin.

Niru baaretz, dehay eretz mitbarcha minnayyhu kadka chaze. umay ihi. eretz kaddisha, eretz illaa, eretz vadday. et hazzamir higgia, iddan leakera shuletanuta deravreve ammin dela yishletun behu beyisrael, beshaata deittekam mashkena.

Vkol hattor nishma beartzenu, da eretz diltatta, deachasinu yisrael al yeda dihoshua. man hu kol hattor. da hu tayyayr illaa, deizdeuvg immah kad bana shelomo be makdesha letatta, ucheden itattar kudesha berich hu beitroy, kechatan bechalla. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vegomer.

Besifra deaggadta amar, kol hattor, da tora shebbeal pe, detora devichtav ikre tora setam, tora shebbeal pe ikre tor, kema deat amer vayyikker vayyikra, da shelimu, veda lav hachi, vaana okimna kema deittemar, vehachi hu.

Ta chaze, kad nachtat shechinta lemashkena, ketiv kallot moshe, chaser 6, kallat moshe vadday, veukemuha. aval raza demilla, kallat moshe: da keneset yisrael, vecholla chad milla, ulemalka illaa ittemar. kevan deittetkam mashkena kaim moshe levar, amar la itchaze lemeal ella birshuta, miyyad vayyikra el moshe. man vayyikra. da hahi deveta dilah hi, hahi kalla dechol beta birshuta dilah. (Vayikra 1) vaydabber Adonai elav, hahu deikre kol, hahu deachid beh moshe.

Vayyikra el moshe, ribbi elazar patach, (Yeshayahu 50:2) maddua bati veen ish karati veen one hakatzor katzra yadi mippedut. zakkain innun yisrael, divchol atar deishtechachu, kudesha berich hu ishtechach immehon, vekudesha berich hu ishtechach benihon, umitpaer behu beyisrael, hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Vlo od, ella deyisrael ashlimu mehemnuta beara. veyisrael shelimu dishma kaddisha innun. vechad yisrael ishtelimu beovadayyhu, kivyachol, shema kaddisha ishtelim. vechad yisrael la ishtelimu letatta beovadayyhu, veitchayyeyvu galuta, kivyachol shema kaddisha la shelim leella. ditnan da salik veda nachit, yisrael dilella salik leella. keneset yisrael nechitat letatta, itrechaku da min da, kivyachol ishtear shema kaddisha bela shelimu. vecholla begin dichneset yisrael begaluta.

Vaf al gav deyisrael begaluta, kudesha berich hu ishtechach benayyhu, veate veakdim leve kenishta, vekare vamar, (Yirmeyahu 3:22) shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem. velet man deittear rucheh, keden kudesha berich hu amar, madua bati veen ish karati veen one. akdamit, ven ish, vlet man deyittear rucheh.

Ta chazi, behahu yoma deishtachlal be mashkena, kudesha berich hu akdim veshari beh. miyyad, vayyikra el moshe vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. vaydabber Adonai elav, veoda leh dizminin yisrael lemechav kammeh, uleitmashkena hay ohel moed bechovayyhu, vla yitkeyaym bidayyhu (sefer acher bahadayyhu), hada hu dichtiv vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. may amar leh. meohel moed, meiske ohel moed, dezammin leitmashkena bechovayyhu deyisrael, vela yitkeyyaym bekiyyumeh. aval asvavta lehay, adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. hare lach karbenin deagin al kolla.
Ribbi chizkiyya, hava shechiach kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh,
1042: Hay deikre karban, keruv mibbae leh, o kerivut, may karban. amar leh ha yedia hu legabbe chavrayyay, karban meinnun kitrin kaddishin, demitkarve kullehu kachada, umitkashsheran da beda, ad deitavedu kullehu chad, beyichuda shelim, leatkena shema kaddisha kadka chaze, hada hu dichtiv karban laAdonai. karban deinnun kitrin kaddishin laAdonai hu, leittakna shema kaddisha, uleyachada leh kedka yeot, begin deyishtechachu rachamin bechullehu almin. ushema kaddisha deitattar beitroy leitbassema kolla.

Vechol da begin leatteara rachame, vela leitteara dina. uvegin kach laAdonai hu, vela lelohim. laAdonai: anan tzerichim leitteara rachame, vela lelohim, rachame baenan vela dina. amar, zakkaa chulaki deshailna veravavchna millin illen, veda beriru demilla. aval ha ketiv (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara, lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze. zivche elohim ketiv, velo zivche Adonai.

Amar leh, vadday hachi hu, karban elohim la ketiv, ella zivche elohim. veal da shechitatan batzafon, deha zevicha hu begin elohim, hahu setar gevura, deyitbesam veyitbar rucha dedina, veyitchallash dina, veyitgabberun rachame al dina. veal da zivche elohim, letavra chela vetukepa dedina kashya, dichtiv ruach nishbara, lemeheve hahu rucha takkifa nishbara, vela yitgabbar rucheh vecheleh vetukepeh. ubbar nash bae keden, lemekam al madbecha, beruach nishbara, veyachsif meovadoy, begin dihve hahu rucha takkifa tevira, vecholla begin dedina yittevssam, veyitgabberun rachame al dina.

(Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. amar ribbi elazar, hay kera hachi hava leh lemichtav, adam ki yakriv karban laAdonai. mahu mikkem. ella laafuke adam harishon, dehu akriv karbena kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, veha ukemuha, vehacha mikkem ketiv, hay adam, laafuke adam ochora, dela hava mikkem. amar leh ribbi shimon, shappir kaamart, vhachi hu.

Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 48:1) shir mizmor livne korach. hay shir tushebachta mealya hu, al kol shear tushebachin, dezachu leshabbecha leh bene korach. shir mizmor: tushebachta al tushebachta. tushebachta deitpelag litren tushebchan.

Vezachu bene korach leshabbecha lah lichneset yisrael. ushevacha dichneset yisrael ka amre. umay hu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:2) gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho. ematay ikre kudesha berich hu gadol, bezimna dichneset yisrael ishtechachat immeh, hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 231) beir elohenu, hu gadol beir elohenu, im ir elohenu.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, elohenu may bae hacha. amar leh hachi hu vday, hay ir dechala elohenu, (sefer acher chela) vetushebachta deyisrael hu. may mashma. ishtema, demalka bela matronita, lav hu malka, velav hu gadol, vela mehullal. uvegin kach, kol man dela ishtechach dechar venukeba, kol shevacha adoy minneh, velav hu bichlala deadam. velo od ella delav ihu keday leitbarcha.

Ketiv (Iyov 1:3) vayhi haish hahu gadol mikkol bene kedem, tanenan besifra derav hamenuna sava, devat zugo bidchilu dekudesha berich hu havat kevvteh, umissitra deitteteh ikre gadol. uf hacha, gadol Adonai umehullal meod, uvemma hu gadol. hadar veamar, beir elohenu har kadsho.

Uvegin kach, tushebachta da bashsheni. vei tema amay la ketiv ki tov bashsheni. begin dizminin leitparsha. veraza demilla (Bereshit 2:18) lo tov hyot haadam levaddo, bezimna deihu levaddo lo tov ketiv. veal da la ketiv ki tov bashsheni.

Gadol Adonai umehullal kidkamran. yefe nof mesos kol haaretz, tushebachta deziuuga dilhon. yefe nof, da kudesha berich hu, veda tzaddik, mesos kol haaretz, keden hu chedvvta decholla, ucheneset yisrael mitbarcha.
Elohim bearmenoteha noda lemisgav vegomer, illen innun netzach vehod,
1043: Detaman kenishuta dechol birchan, kenishuta dechedvevta. mittamman nafka al yede dehay darga deikre tzaddik, vetamman itkenashu birchan, levassema lehay ir kaddisha, uleitbarcha mittamman. ki hinne hammelachim noadu. illen kol kitre malka bichlala chada, velaatar ochora millin illen sallekin.

Ta chazi, beshaata devar nash metakken ovadoy al yede dekarbena, kolla itbesam veitkerav, veitkeshar da beda, beyichuda shelim. hada hu dichtiv adam ki yakriv mikkem. ki yakriv lekashshera millin kadka chaze.

Ta chazi, adam ki yakriv, laafuke man dela itnesiv, deha karbaneh lav karban, uvirkan la mishtakkechan legabbeh, (sefer acher al yedeh) la leella, vela letatta. mimmashma dichtiv adam ki yakriv, shane hacha, delav ihu adam, vela bichlala deadam hu, ushechinta la sharya alohi, begin deihu pagim, veikre baal mum, umare demuma itrachaka mikkolla, kol shekken lemadbecha lekarva karbena.

Vnadav vaavihu ochachan, dichtiv, (Vayikra 9:24) vattetze esh millifni Adonai. uvegine kach ketiv, adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai, adam deishtechachu dechar venukeba, hay chaze lekarva karbena da, vla ochora.

Veamar ribbi abba, af al gav deukemuha lenadav vaavihu bemilla ochora, hachi hu vday. aval ketoret, illaa hu mikkol karbenin dealma, dealeh itbarchan illae vetattae. vekarbena da deihu leella mikkol karbenin la itchazun innun lekarva, deha la itnesivu, lekarbana la itchazun, kol shekken lemillin illain, deyitbarchun al yedayyhu.

Vei tema vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam, amay. lebar nash deata kame matronita, levassera lah deha malka ate levetah, veyishre bah bematronita, lemechde immah. ata lekame malka, chama malka hahu bar nash deihu mare demumin. amar malka, lav hu yekara dili, deal yedoy dehay pagim, iul lematronita. addehachi atkenat matronita beta lemalka, kevan dechamat demalka hava zammin lemete legabbah, vehahu bar nash garim leistalleka malka minnah, keden pekidat matronita lekatla lehahu bar nash.

Kacha bezimna dealu nadav vaavihu, uketoret bidayyhu, chaddat matronita, veittakkenat lekabbela lemalka. kevan dechama malka innun guvrin pegimin, mare demumin, la baa malka deal yedayyhu yete lemishre immah, veistellak malka minnah. kad chamat matronita divginehon istallak malka minnah, miyyad vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam.

Vchol da begin deman dela itnesiv hu pagim. mareh demumin kodam malka, kedushsha demalka istallak minneh, vela sharya bifgimu. veal da ketiv adam ki yakriv mikkem karban, man deikre adam yakriv, uman dela ikre adam la yakriv.
Min habbehema kelal. min habbakar umin hatztzon perat, levatar illen dechashrin lemechal, udela kashshiryan lemechal asir lekarva. velaatar ochora istaliku innun dechashran veinnun dela kashran.

(Vayikra 1:3) im ola karbano, ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 55:8) ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem velo darchechem derachay. ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem, machshevotay ketiv chaser belo 6, ta chaze, machashava dekudesha berich hu, hi illaa veresha decholla, umehahi machashava itpeshshatu archin ushevilin, leishtakkecha shema kaddisha, uleatkena leh betikkunoy kedka yeot. umehahi machashava itnegid venafik shakyu deginta deeden, leashkaa kolla. umehahi machashava, kayymin illain vetattain. umehahi machashava, mishtechach tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe.

Machashava debar nash, hi resha decholla, umehahi machashava, itpeshshatu archin ushevilin, leastaa orchoy, behay alma, uvealma deate. umehahi machashava, itnegid venafik zuhama deyetzer hara, leavasha leh ulecholla. umehahi machashava, ishtechachu averot chataot uzedonot, avoda zara, giluy arayot ushefichut damim. veal da, ki
1044: Uvegin kach, resha decholla ketiv, im ola karbano. min habbakar, vela bakar, uman ihu. par ben bakar ihu, deihu dechar. ribbi yitzchak amar, min habbakar setam, vechazar uferash zachar tamim yakrivennu, zachar vla nekeva, deha (79) dechar ishtemoda leella, venukeba ishtemoda letatta. vechen min hatztzon min hakkevasim umin haizzim.

Man deate leola, kullehu dechar, vela nukeba, begin deola ola al hallev, al hallev vday, veishtemoda man dekaim al hallev. uvegin kach salleka leella, vechullehu dichrin. veal da patach kera beresha baola yattir mikkol shear karbanin, deha machashava resha decholla.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi baatar demachashava dilella baya lekarva, amay letatta yattir. la hava bideh. ata lekameh deribbi shimon, amar leh, resha decholla machashava hu, vesiyyuma dehahi machashava atar deikre boker, umay ihu. hahu siyyuma degufa, dimvassem lenukeba. kach machashava debar nash, resha decholla. siyyuma dehahi machashava, kad itavid ovada. ematay. babboker. hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 2:1) hoy choshve avn ufoale ra, ematay, al mishkevotam beor habboker yaasuha. veal da lehahu atar demachashava, machashava istelik. veovada mitkarva lesiyyuma demachashava vday.

Ribbi acha hava azil bearcha, vhava immeh ribbi yehuda, ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi yehuda, ha detanenan betulat yisrael, betula deitbarcha min sheva (sefer acher miyyisrael), deikre bat sheva, vukemuha bechamma atar. uvetula letatta, yarta 7 berachot beginah. veha ketiv veatta ben adam sa kina al betulat yisrael, vday alah ittemar, al keneset yisrael. vda kashya mikkolla, dichtiv (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael. vehay deka amre kullehu chavrayyay bemilla da shappir hu. aval i parsheta ittemar beorach nechama havinan amre hachi. aval behay kina ittemar, veha kera ochach hachi.

Amar leh vday hachi hu, veha hava kashya li hahu milla yattir mikkolla, veatenan legabbe deribbi shimon, bachashochan deanpin. amar li, mechezu deanpach, ishtemoda ma divlibbach. amena leh vday, deanpi velibbi shavin. amar li emma li milach. amena leh, ketiv nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael, man deit leh rugeza bidvithu, venafka minneh, la tehadar lealmin, i hachi vavy livnin deitterachu immah. amar li, vela sagge lach ma deamru kullehu chavrayyay. amena, ha shemana millayyhu, dehavi merachame, vela mityashshevan belibbay.

Amar, kol ma deamru chavrayyay kolla shappir veyaut, aval vavy ledara kad rayayn la mishtakkechin, veana satan veazlin, vela yadin lean atar azle, la limina vela lismala. vadday hay kera baya leminda, vechullehu galyayn leinnun dechaman bearcha deorayyta beorach keshot.

Ta chaze, bechullehu galvavta degalu yisrael, lechullehu shavvi zimna vekitza, uvechullehu havo yisrael tayyvin lekudesha berich hu, uvetulat yisrael hava tavat leatraha, behahu zimna degazar alah. vehasheta begaluta da batraa lav hachi, deha hi la tituv hachi kezimnin ochoranin, vehay kera ochach, dichtiv nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael, nafla velo osif lahakima la ketiv.

Metal lemalka deragaz al matronita, veashde lah mehechaleh, lezimna yedia. kad hava mate hahu zimna, miyyad matronita havat alat vetavat kame malka. vechen zimna chad, uteren, utelat zimnin. lezimna batrayyta, itrachakat mehechala demalka, veashde lah malka mehechaleh lezimna rechika. amar malka, hay zimna lav hu kishar zimnin dehi tete kamay hachi, ella ana ezil im kol beni hechali vatba alah.
Kad mata legabbah, chama lah dehava shechivat leafra. man chama yekara dematronita behahi
1045: Zimna, uvautin demalka lokovlah ad deachid lah malka bidoy, veokim lah, veayyte lah lehechaleh, veome lah dela yitperash minnah lealmin, vela yitrechik minnah.

Kacha kudesha berich hu, kol zimnin dichneset yisrael begaluta, kad hava mate zimna, hi atiat vehaderat kame malka. vehasheta begaluta da lav hachi, ella kudesha berich hu yochid bidaha, veyokim lah, veyitpeyays bahadah veyativ lah lehechaleh. veta chaze dehachi hu, deha ketiv nafla lo tosif kum, veal da ketiv, (Amos 9:11) bayyom hahu akim et sukkat david hanofelet, hi lo tosif kum kezimnin ochoranin, aval ana okim lah. veal da ketiv bayyom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet, ani akim et sukkat david. man sukkat david. da betulat yisrael. hannofelet: kema dichtiv nafla. veda hi yekara divtulat yisrael, vetushebachta dilah. veda olifna behahi shaata.

Amar ribbi yehuda, vadday malilta al libbay, veityishva, veda beriru demilla. veazla hay, kemila chada deshamana veshachachna, vehasheta ravvchna lah, detanenan, amar ribbi yose, zammin kudesha berich hu leachreza al keneset yisrael veyema, (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushala 40, keman deachid bida dechavreh veyema hitnaer, kum, kach kudesha berich hu yochid bah veyema hitnaari, kumi.

Amar leh ribbi acha, vechen kol innun bene hechala demalka belishana da patchin, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:1) kumi ori ki va orech, ha malka hacha, vadday keden hu yekara dilah, vechedvavta decholla, kad malka itpeyays bahadah. (ketiv 1 vattavo bat sheva el hammelech hachadra kegavvna da) bechol innun zimnin ihi atat legabbe demalka, vekamat kameh, hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 1:28) vattavo lifni hammelech, vattaamod lifni hammelech. aval bezimna da lav hachi, ella malka yete legabbah, veyitpeyays bahadah, veyetiv lah lehechaleh. hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 9:9) hinne malkech yavo lach vadday, vela ant legabbeh, yavo lach, lefayyeysa lach. yavo lach, leakkama lach. yavo lach, leashlema lach becholla. yavo lach, lealaa lach lehechaleh, uleizdavvevga immach ziuuga dealmin, kema deat amer (Hoshea 2:22) verastich li beemuna.
Ad dahavo azle paga behu ribbi abba. amru, ha mareh dechachmeta ate, nekabbel anpe shechinta. kad kerivu bahaddeh, ishtemit mikkastora dekufetra, venachat gabbon.

Patach vamar, (Shemot 19:19) vayhi kol hashshofar holech vechazek meod vegomer. vyhi kol hashshofar, hacha afligu sifre kadmae, vechullehu bechad milla ittekau. it man deamar, kol hashshofar tere, kol chad, hashshofar tere. vedayik lah, middela ketiv vayhi hashshofar holech vechazek, ella kol hashshofar, kol denafik mishshofar, devday shofar ikre, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 27:13) yittaka beshofar gadol, vehay ihu shofar gadol, deveh nafkin avdin lecherut almin. veha ukemuha.

Vit man detane vedayik decholla chad, begin dichtiv kol hashshofar, kol deikre shofar. vmna lan deikre kol. mimma dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:19) kol gadol velo yasaf, vehay kol gadol ikre shofar. veal da kol hashshofar holech ketiv. lean holech. i tema lehar sinay, o leyisrael. yored mibbae leh. ella orayyta mehacha nafka. umeatar da, deihu kelala dechol shear kalin ityeyhivat, vchad yistakkelun mille kolla chad.

Val da, luche kadmae reshimin mehay atar havo, veda hu raza demilla dichtiv, (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot, al tikre charut, ella cherut, cherut mammash, atar dechol cheru beh talya. veta chazi, let lach milla beorayyta, deamrin kullehu chavrayyay da hachi veda hachi, dela azil kolla laatar chad, ulemabbua chad itkenash.

Holecha: kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam. uchetiv (Kohelet 1) hakkol holech el makom echad. vechazek meod, kama detanenan keli machazik arbaim sea. vechazek meod, delet lach milla beorayyta chalasha o tevira, dechad tistechal vetinda bah, dela tishkach lah takkifa kefattisha dematbar tinarin. vei ihi chalasha, minach hu. kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Devarim lak) ki lo davar rek hu, veim rek hu, mikkem ihu. veal da vechazek meod.
1046: Ketiv (Shemot 19:19) moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol, baatar da itkelilu millin illain, ha ukemuha vehaelohim yaannnu vekol, bekolo shel moshe, behahu kol deachid beh moshe. hacha it leistakkela deha ippecha hava, dichtiv (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim, vehacha ketiv moshe yedabber.

Ella it deamre, begin dichtiv, (Shemot 20:16) vayyomru el moshe dabber atta immanu venishmaa veal yedabber immanu elohim. veal da moshe yedabber, vehaelohim yaanennu. begin dela ishtechach milla beorayyta mippuma demoshe (266) bilchodoy, veda hu deukemuha, kelalot shebbemishne tora moshe mippi atzmo amaran. meatzmo la tanenan, ella mippi atzmo, hallalu mippi haggevura. vehallalu mippi atzmo, mippi hahu kol deachid beh, deikre hachi. veshappir milla.

Uvesifra deaggadta deve rav amre, af al gav deorayyta mippi haggevura ittemar kulah, mippi atzmo shel moshe kemo ken ittemar. umay ihu. kegon kelalot shebbemishne tora. ulevatar itteklilan bigvura, hada hu dichtiv moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol. moshe yedabber, da kolo shel moshe. vehaelohim yaanennu vekol, da gevura, deode leh lehahu kala. hada hu dichtiv yaanennu vekol behahu kol demoshe. vhasheta man defatach bemille deorayyta, (anan echde navedan leh, amehav nasiv uman defatach) liftach vyema, yatvu.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, ketiv (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah vegomer, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avoda zara, deha kudesha berich hu kad bara alma, la bara leh ella beginehon deyisrael, begin diykabbelun orayyta betura desinay, veyitdachun becholla, vyishtakkechun zakkain kameh.

Ta chazi, kad ishtelim hay alma behu beyisrael, kegavvna dilella, vehahu adam itneitz beara, verumeh mate ad tzet shemaya, baa kudesha berich hu leashlema (sefer acher laashalepaa) nishmeta kaddisha meella letatta, begin deyitachid vyitkeshar da beda, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama vegomer. lemeheve kashir da beda, veyishtekach shelim kegavvna dilella, veyashlim vitakken garmeh hache.

Uvegin kach bara leh dechar venukeba, lemeheve shelim. veematay ikre bar nash shelim kegavvna dilella beshaata deizdavvivg bevat zugeh beachaduta bechedvavta biruta, veyappik minneh uminukeveh ben (260) uvat. ucheden hu bar nash shelim kegavvna dilella, veashlim hu letatta, kegavvna dishma kaddisha illaa, ucheden itkere (sefer acher itkeyyaym) shema kaddisha illaa aleh.

Uvar nash dela bae leashlema shema kaddisha letatta, tav leh dela itbere, deha let leh chulaka kelal bishma kaddisha. vechad nafik nishmateh minneh, la itachada beh kelal, deha azara diyyukena demareh ad deitkashshera (sefer acher daatahedarea) vittakkenat becholla.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vegomer. uvat kohen, da nishmeta kaddisha, deitkere beratta demalka, deha ukemuha denishmeta kaddisha miziuuga demalka umatronita nafkat. uvegine kach hech gufa diltatta middechar venukeba, uf hachi nishmeta leella. ki tihye almana mehahu gufa deizdavvevgat beh, umit. ugerusha, deittarchat mehahu chulaka dishma kaddisha. vechol kach lamma, begin dezra en lah leishtakkecha kegavvna dilella, uleitkashshera bishma kaddisha. veshava el bet aviha, man veshava. veshava setam, leittakna kemillekaddemin. ucheden veshava el bet aviha, da kudesha berich hu. kinureha: kekadmeta. millechem aviha tochel, leitannega beinnuga demalka.

Mikkan ulehala, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. man hu zar. hahu dela (sefer acher okim) shema kaddisha detatta, velet leh beh chulaka. lo ychal kodesh, let beh chulaka meinnuga dilella deit beh achila, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ichlu reim, achila dilella, innuga
1047: Dekudesha berich hu havi, vehay innuga sharya, baatar desharya kad recha dekarbena hava salik.

Ta chaze, beshaata deishtechach mezona letatta, ishtechach mezona leella. lemalka deatkan seudata dileh, vela atkan leavdohi. kad atkan leavdohi, achil hu seudata dileh, veinnun achle seudatayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yari im divshi, da seudata demalka. ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim, da seudata didhu merecha dekarbena, kad recha dekarbena hava salik. uvegine kach ikre reach nichoach laAdonai. reach leavdohi. nichoach laAdonai. (meatar deinnuga deattika ishtechach) veal da seudata demalka itakkav, begin seudata deavdohi. uvegin kach, yisrael mefarnese laavihen shebbashshamayim tanenan. umisudata demalka man achil. ella innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay.

Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 133:1) hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad, zakkain innun yisrael, dela yahav lon kudesha berich hu leravreva, o lishlicha, ella yisrael achidan beh, vehu achid behu, umechavivuta dilhon kara lon kudesha berich hu avdin. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:55) ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem. levatar kara lon banim, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. levatar kara lon achim, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay vegomer. uvegin dekara lon achim, baa leshavvava madoreh behu, vela yade minnayyhu. keden ketiv hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad.

Uvutzina kaddisha hachi amar, hinne ma tov uma naim vegomer, kema deat amer (Vayikra 20:14) veish asher yikkach et achoto. uvesifra derav yeva sava, veish: da kudesha berich hu. asher yikkach et achoto: da cheneset yisrael. vechol kach lamma. chesed hu, chesed hu vadday, veha ukemuha. veal da hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad, kudesha berich hu uchenset yisrael. gam, lerabbot yisrael diltatta. kidamrinan, deha beshaata dichneset yisrael (sefer acher beachvavta beachaduta) beachaduta bekudesha berich hu, yisrael diltatta sharyayn bechedvavta gam innun bekudesha berich hu. uvegin kach gam yachad ketiv. uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, (77) gam yachad, lerabbot tzaddik. bah, bichneset yisrael, deinnun ziuuga chad, vecholla milla chad.

Vetaninan befarsheta dishma yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, mahu echad. da keneset yisrael deachid beh bekudesha berich hu. deamar ribbi shimon, ziuuga didchar venukeba ikre echad. baatar denukeba sharya, echad ikre. may taama. begin didchar bela nukeba pelag gufa ikre, ufellag lav hu chad. vechad mitchabberan kachada tere palge gufa, itavidu chad gufa, ucheden ikre echad.

Vhasheta kudesha berich hu la ikre echad. veraza demilla, keneset yisrael begaluta, vekudesha berich hu salik leella leella, veziuuga itperash, ushema kaddisha la ishtechach shelim, veechad la ikre. veematay yitkere echad, beshaata dematronita tishtechach beh bemalka, veyizdavvevgun kachada. hada hu dichtiv, (Ovadya 1:21) vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. man melucha. da keneset yisrael, demalchu bah itkeshar, keden (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. veal da, hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad.

(Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh. man shemen hattov. da meshach revut kudesha, denagid venafik meattika kaddisha, deishtechach behahu nahar illaa, deyanka livnin, leadleka butzinin, vehahu meshach nagid beresha demalka, umeresheh likiru dedikna kaddisha, umittamman nagid lechol innun levushe yekar demalka itlabbash behu. hada hu dichtiv sheyyored al pi middotav. al pi middotav mammash, veillen innun kitri malka dishmeh kaddisha ishtechach behu.

Ta chaze, kol negidu, vechol chedu dealmin, la nachit levarcha, ella al yeda deillen kitrin kaddishin, deinnun shema demalka kaddisha, uvegin kach sheyyored al pi middotav. al pi middotav vday kema deat amer (Bamidbar 4:27) al pi aharon uvanav tihye. kach al pi middotav, nachit venagid lechullehu almin, leishtakkecha birchan lecholla. veta chazi, hay shemen
1048: Tov la zammin, ad hahu zimna defulechana diltatta hava salik, veitaran da beda, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev. shemen leella, uketoret letatta, keden hu chedvavta decholla. ribbi acha veribbi yehuda zekifu yedin, veodu leribbi abba.

Ribbi acha patach, (Bereshit 20:3) vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayla, uchetiv vayyomer elav haelohim bachalom gam anochi yadati ki vetam levavcha asita zot. hay vayyavo elohim el avimelech, may shena beumot haolam, vayyavo elohim, uleyisrael la. (ella da hu raza deelohim acherim veit lecha leminda dishma dekudesha berich hu 1 ram venasa shochen ad vekadosh shemo vehu bilchodoy malka al kol ma deishtechach ben leella ben letatta vehechala kaddisha dileh beemtzaita ittakkan vasecharenayh it shivin kitrin uminnehon itmashchu 70 ravrevin vaatamenav al 70 ammin dealma lemeheve kol chad vechad shallit al immeh veal areh. vekudesha berich hu yahev leyisrael raza dishmeh bilchodehon vehu shallit al yisrael virushalayim hada hu dichtiv 2 ki shimcha nikra al ircha veal immach. velet leamma achara chulaka beh bekudesha berich hu dichtiv 3 ureu kol ammi haaretz ki sham Adonai nikra alecha. uchetiv 4 ki kol haammim yelchu ish beshem elohav vegomer. uchetiv 5 ki chelek Adonai immo vegomer) ella hachi tanenan, kol elohim dehacha, hahu chela ravreva dimmana alayyhu hava, kegavvna da vayyavo elohim el bilam layla, hahu chela deitpekad aleh.

Vei tema vayyomer elav haelohim bachalom. hachi hu vadday, gam anochi yadati, gam amay hacha. ella lerabbot ka ata, deaf al gav dilella minnay yedia, gam anochi yadati. vaechshoch gam anochi, gam lerabbot, otcha mechato li, mechato chaser alef ketiv, may kaamar begin dechattaa lav bechela kayyeyma.

Ella hachi olifna, bechovehon deamma diltatta, itpegim leella. bechove amma diltatta, itabbar ravreva dilhon dilella mishshuletanih. hada hu dichtiv vaechshoch gam anochi otcha, deaf al gav dilella minnay talya milleta, gam anochi lerabbot legarmeh, mechato li, begin dela yishtechachu gabbay, kehay machat denaitz bevisra, dela tigrom li at bechovach leabera li mishuletani, viykutzun bi, dela takotz li bemachatach, kema deat amer (Vayikra 20:23) vaakutz bam, kehane kotzin dinitzin bevisra. may mashma. mashma divchove beni enasha, avdin pegimu leella, may ihu. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shullecha immechem.

Val da karban itkeriv, may karban. hay dekamran dichtiv, uvefishachem shullecha immechem. deha chet garim piruda bechoveh. karban kariv alma illaa bealma tattaa veitavid kolla chad. atu ribbi abba veribbi yehuda, veodu leh leribbi acha.

Patach ribbi yehuda (26) veamar, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha vegomer. ivdu et Adonai besimcha, hachi olifna, dechol pulechana devae bar nash lemiflach lekudesha berich hu, bae bechedvavta, biruta delibba, begin deyishtechach pulechanih bishlimu. vei tema pulechana dekarbena hachi hu. la efshar, deha hahu bar nash deavar al pikkuda demareh, al pikkuda deorayyta, vetav lekamme demareh, beman anpin yekum kameh, ha vadday beruach tevira, beruach atziv, an hu simcha, an hu renana.

Ella tamman tanenan, hahu bar nash dechate kamme mareh, veavar al pikkodoy, veate lekarva karbena, uletakkena garmeh, beruach tevira, beruach atziva bae leishtakkecha, vei bache shappir mikkolla. ha simcha ha renana la ishtechach. ella bemay ittekkan. behanehu kahane velevae, deha innun ashlimu simcha urenana begineh. simcha bechahana itkayyaym, begin dehu rechika min dina tadir, vechahana bae leishtakkecha tadir beanpin nehirin, chaddan yattir mikkol amma. deha kitra dileh garim. renana belevae, vehachi hu, deha levae mishtakkeche al shir lealmin, kema deukemuha.
1049: Aleh, uveh ishtelim pulechana lekudesha berich hu. kahana kaim aleh vechavvivn millin, bechedvavta biruta, leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yaut. velevae beshir. keden ketiv deu ki Adonai hu elohim. da hu karban lekarva rachame bedina, umitbesam kolla.

Hasheta dela ishtechach karbena, man dechate kame mareh vetav legabbeh, vadday bimriru denafsha, baatzivu, bevichya, beruach tevira, heach okim simcha urenana, ha la ishtechachu gabbeh. ella hachi okmuha, detushebchan demareh, vechedvavta deorayyta, urenana deorayyta, da hu simcha urenana. veha tanenan vela mittoch atzvut vechulei, dela yekum bar nash kameh mareh baatzivu veha la yachil umay takanteh.

Ella raza demilla, ha tanenan leolam yikkanis adam shiur sheni petachim vechulei, vitzale tzeloteh hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:34) lishmor mezuzot petachay, shene petachim salleka datach, ella emma shiur shene petachim. kan remez lemma sheamar david, (Tehillim 24:7) seu shearim rashechem, innun maon umachon, deinnun go lego, sheruta dedargin: chesed, ufachad. veinnun pitchin dealma. al da itzterich bar nash deyitkavvivn bitzloteh lokovel kodesh kudeshin, deinnun shema kaddisha, vitzale tzeloteh. vehanehu illen shiur 2 pitchin, 2 kitrin.

Vit dematne hache, simcha, da keneset yisrael. vesimcha ha ukemuha, kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:12) ki besimcha tetzeu vegomer. uzeminin yisrael lenafka min galuta, behay simcha. uman ihi keneset yisrael. veal da ivdu et Adonai besimcha, kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh, vecholla chad.

Bou lefanav birnana, da shelimu dilah. desimcha ballev, urenana bappe. veda hu shelimu yattir. ushelimu dehay simcha ha ishtemoda, veha yedia. veda hu tikkuna devar nash lekammeh mareh. keden deu ki Adonai hu haelohim. vecholla bechad milla atya, devae levatar leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot, ulekashshera da beda lemehevi kolla chad, veda hu pulechana dekudesha berich hu. amru leh ribbi acha veribbi abba, vday hachi hu. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, veyade archoy dekudesha berich hu, kamu veazlu avatreh deribbi abba, 3 millin.

Patach ribbi abba (hakedama 11) veamar, (Tehillim Adonai:8) vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha, hachi ukemuha, dela live leh levar nash lemeal leve kenishta, ella i imlach bekadmita, beavraham veyitzchak veyaakov. begin deinnun takkinu tzelota lekamme dekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha. avo vetecha: da avraham. eshtachav el hechol kadshecha: da yitzchak. beyiratecha: da yaakov, (sefer acher vaani berov chasdecha da avraham. abba betecha da yaakov, eshtachave el hechal kodshecha beyiratecha, da yitzchak.) uvaa leachlela lon beresha, veyeul leve kenishta, vitzale tzeloteh. keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

(Vayikra 1:3) im ola karbano min habbakar. amar ribbi yose, may shena min habbakar leola, umin hatztzon leola, umin haof leola. i kolla chad, begin ma shanya da min da, deha min kolla itavid chad milla. ella, man deadbak yedeh leda, makriv min habbakar. vei la yachil, min hatztzon. vei la yachil min haof. deha ketiv, (Vayikra 14:21) veim dal hu veen yado masseget, deha kudesha berich hu la atrach aleh devar nash yattir, bemilla dela yachil.

Amar ribbi elazar, kema dehava chattaa hachi hava makriv. atira, dezimnin delibbeh gas beh, hava makriv tora. begin delibbeh chashiv yattir lemechete kameh mareh. benoni, makriv min hatztzon, begin diruteh lav gas beh kol kach lemechote. miskena delibbeh la gas beh, reuteh namoch mikkolla, makriv mehahu kalil mikkolla. veishtemodan karbenehon lechullehu, kol chad vechad bilchodayyhu, vekudesha berich hu dain dina kol chad vechad bematkela yeshara.

Ribbi elazar shail leribbi shimon avuhi, amar leh, ha tanenan deal telat chove alma raav ba leolam, vechullehu chove la mishtakkeche ella beatire, begin delibbayyhu gas behu, vela mishtakkeche bemiskene, ma dina
1050: Hu, dekudesha berich hu katil lemiskene, vekaim laatire, deha mehasheta yosifun lemechote kameh. amar leh yeot shaalta veha ukemuha chavrayyay veamru, kad baa kudesha berich hu leitpara min rashshiayya uleovada lehu min alma, keden yahiv lehu shalom, vashlim lehu becholla.

Aval ta chazi, dechol bene alma la mishtakkechin kerivin lemalka illaa, keillen manin deihu ishtammash behu. uman innun. (Tehillim 51:19) lev nishbar vnidke. (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. illen innun mane demalka. vechad ishtechach batzoret bealma, vechafna vedina ittakkaf al miskene, keden bachan vegaoan kame malka, vekudesha berich hu kariv lon yattir mikkolla, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 22:25) ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani. ucheden kudesha berich hu pakid al ma atya kafna lealma. vavy leinnun chayyayvayya degarme hay.

Kad itar malka leashgecha bealma al kala demiskeni, rachamana lishezvan minnayyhu, umeulebnayyhu, keden ketiv, (Shemot 22:22) shamoa eshma tzaakato. shamoa eshma tere zimne: chad leashgecha bekalehon. vechad leitpara min innun degarmin lon hay. hada hu dichtiv, veshamati ki channun ani vechara appi vegomer. veal da beshaata dechafna ishtechach bealma, vavy leinnun atire chayyayvayya, bekalehon demiskeni lekame kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze dehahu karbena demiskena, kalil (nusach acher kaheb) mikkolla, begin delibbeh tavir, veaf al gav dechashiv lemechete, itabbar minneh. deha day leh betzaareh, udeinshe beteh. veal da kol karbena vekarbena, kol chad vechad bilchodoy, ishtemodan kullehu legabbe kahana.

Ovada behahu atira, dekariv kame kahana teren yonin, kad chama leh kahana, amar leh, lav didach hu hay karbena. ata leveteh vahava atziv. amru leh achuy amay at atziv. amar lehu, dela kariv li kahana karbena dili. amru leh umay ihu. amar lehu teren yonin. amru leh, veha min miskena ihu, velav didach. deha ketiv, veim dal hu veen yado masseget vegomer. ella kariv karbenach. amar lehu may ihu. amru leh chad tora.

Amar lehu, uma kol kach chamira machashava dechattaa. nadarna, dela asllak al libbay machashava dechattaa. mittamman ulehala ma avad. kol yoma ishtaddal bischorata, uvelelya hava naim, kad itar, hava kare laachoy, veolifu leh mile deorayyta, vhava lae ad desalik yemama. veishtechach deolif orayyta, vahava kare leh yehuda ochora. yoma chad ira beh ribbi yesa sava, vhava parish nichsoy, palgu lemiskene ufalgu lischorata al yamma, beinnun gavrin perishe yamin. vhava yativ vlae beorayyta.

Patach veamar, (Shmuel 1 15:6) vayyomer shaul el hakkeni. man hu keni. illen bene yitro chamuy demoshe, deavdu kinna bemadbera, kehay deror, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 84:4) uderor ken lah. begin lemile beorayyta. deorayyta la baya tafnukin, vela sechorta, ella leaamla bah yemama velele. begin kach natlu lemadbera, meinnuga diricho, hada hu dichtiv, (Shoftim 1:16) uvene keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim vegomer.
Vatta asita chesed im kol bene yisrael. begin deahani lemoshe beveteh. umoshe kelala dechol yisrael hava. vetu, begin deolif parsheta chada yattir beorayyta, uveda avid chesed im yisrael.

Amay ka ata hacha milla da bemilchamta daamalek. ella amar shaul, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, mikkol shear umin dealma la hava man deizdevvavg lehu leyisrael lekatrega lehu, ella amalek, vehu aved bish leyisrael veagach kerava behu, vant akdemat lehu shelam, veavdat chesed im kullehu, uvegine kach let ant keday leitchabbera behu.
Velo od, ella ma ketiv beh beyitro, (Shemot 18:12) vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzevachim lelohim, dehu akriv karbena lekudesha berich hu, veata leitgayyeyra. may ka mayyre. dekarbeneh
1051: Chashiv kame kudesha berich hu. uvegin deihu akriv karbena lekudesha berich hu, ketiv, (Shemot 12) vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol lechem im choten moshe lifni haelohim. lifne haelohim dayyka. mikkan olifna dechol man deakriv karbena biruta delibba, kudesha berich hu izdeman lokovleh.

Ta chaze, karbena demiskena chashiv kame kudesha berich hu, deha hu kariv tere karbenin lekameh. chad chelbeh vedameh. vechad hahu dekariv. deha let leh lemechal, vehu ayyte karbena. karbena deani kalil mikkolla teren torin, o teren bene yona, vei lav, zeer kimcha, umitkapper beh vehahu shaata machrizin veamre, ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani. kol kach lamma. begin dekarbena deani adif mikkolla. deha hu garim li lemeheve beadveh dekudesha berich hu, hu garim li lemeheve bechulaka deorayyta. begin kach peligna kol nechasay (sefer acher paleygenaa nichse, palga) lemiskene, deha innun garmu li kule hay.

Kema demiskena artach chelbeh vedameh, kach hahu kimcha merattechin leh bimshach revut. vehachi olifna, deafillu kol bar nash mekarev hay mincha al hammachavat uminchat marcheshet. begin, dichmma dechattaa artach chelbeh vedameh beeshsha deyetzer hara, vechol shayyfoy ratche beeshsha, kach karbena da, kehay gavvna mammash. veikara dekarbena kegavvna dechattaa, ulekarva kame kudesha berich hu, reuta delibbeh, verucheh venafsheh, dehay chaviva min kolla kameh.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deinnun mekarvin bechol yoma veyoma hay karbena lekame kudesha berich hu. umay ihu, garmayyhu venafshayyhu dimkarvin kameh. vaana baena lekarva hay karbena (mammash), veda bae kudesha berich hu mibbar nash behay alma. vim kol da karbena decholla (sefer acher mammash) adif, begin deyitbarchun almin kullehu.

Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 135:21) baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam haleluyah. vechi mitztziyyon hu baruch, veha minnahara amika illaa ihu baruch. ella baruch Adonai, kad nahir sihara minnehiru deshimsha, umitkarve da beda, vela adiu nehora da min da. ulezimnin desihara itkere bishma demalka, kema deihu ikre Adonai, kach hi nikret Adonai. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. vela da bilchodohi, ella afillu chad shelicha, lezimnin (mammash) itkere bishma demalka.

Davar acher baruch Adonai mitztziyyon. mean atar ishtemoda dekudesha berich hu, hu baruch. hadar veamar mitztziyyon, meatar detziyyon ishtemoda dehu baruch. may taama. begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:3) ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha vegomer. amar leh ribbi yiyisa zakkaa chulakach dezachit lechule hay. zakkain innun demishtaddelin beorayyta, dechol man deishtedal beorayyta, keillu achid bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom.

Im zevach shelamim karbano. ribbi yehuda patach, (Bereshit 1:6) vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vegomer. ta chaze, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu alma, bara 7 rekiim leella, bara 7 aratzot letatta, 7 yammim, 7 neharot, 7 yomin, 7 shavuot, 7 shanim. 7 peamim. 7 alfe shenin dahave alma, kudesha berich hu bishviaa decholla.

7 Shechakim (sefer acher rekiin) leella, uvechol chad vechad kochavim umazzalot, veshammashin dimshammeshin bechol rekia urekia. uvechullehu meillen, retichin illen al illen, lekabbela alayyhu ol malchuta demarihon. uvechullehu rekiin it retichin veshammashin, meshanyayn da min da, illen al illen, minnehon bev gadpin, uminnehon bed gadpin. minnehon bed panim. uminnehon bitren panim, uminnehon bechad. minnehon eshsha delahit. minnehon mayya. minnehon rucha. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot meshartav esh lohet.

Vechullehu rekiin, illen al illen kegilde betzalim, illen letatta, veillen leella. vechol rekia urekia, azla veraasha meemata demarehon. al pumeh natlin, veal pumeh kayymin. veella mekullehu kudesha berich hu, denatil kolla becheleh vetukepeh. kegavvna da shiva aratzot letatta, vechullehu beyishshuva bar
1052: Deillen illain veillen tattain. veeretz yisrael illaa mikkolla, viyrushala 40 illaa mikkol yishuva.

Vchavrana yatve daroma, chamu besifre kadmae, uvesifra deadam, dehachi mechallek kol innun aratzot, dechullehu mishtakkeche letatta, kegavvna deinnun rekiin dilella. illen al illen, veillen al illen uven kol ara veara, rakia demafrish ben da leda. veal da kullehu aratzot perishan bishmahan. uvenayyhu gan eden vegehinam. veit benayyhu biryayn meshanyayn, illen min illen, kegavvna dilella. minnehon bitren anpin, uminnehon bed, uminnehon be. vechezu deillen lav keillen.

Vi tema, ha kol bene alma meadam nafku, (lav hachi dela) vechi nachit adam harishon lechullehu aratzot, veolid benin, vechamma nashin havo leh. ella, adam la ishtechach ella behay alma illaa mekullehu, deikre tevel, kidamrinan dichtiv (Mishlei 8) (sefer acher mesacheket betevel artzo) vaytzav letevel artzo. vehay tevel achida birkia dilella, veitachida bishma illaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 9:9) vehu yishpot tevel betzedek. betzedek vadday. begin kach benoy deadam, ishtechachu behay ara illaa deikre tevel. vinnun illain al kolla, kegavvna dilella.

May tama. kema dilella lechullehu rekiim, it rakia illaa, mekullehu, uleella ishtechach kisse dekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:26) kemare even sappir demut kisse veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala. uf hacha behay tevel, ishtechach malka decholla, uman ihu adam. ma dela ishtechach bechullehu tattain.

Vinnun tattain mean atu. ella mikistora (nusach acher maketaveraa) deara, vesiua dirkia dilella, nafkin biryayn meshanyayn illen min illen, minnehon bilvushin, minnehon biklifin, keillen tolain demishtakkeche beara, minnehon biklifin sumakin, uchamin chivvavrin, uminnehon mikkol gavvnin. kach kol biryayn kegavvna da. vela ishtechachu bekiyyuma bar eser shenin. (o yattir sefer acher meat o pachot meat)

Uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, parish yattir, deha kol yishuva mitgalgela beigula kakkaddur, illen letatta, veillen leella, vechol innun biryayn meshanyayn bechezvavyyhu mishinuya daavira. kefum kol atar vaatar, vekayymin bekiyyumayyhu kishar bene nasha.

Val da it atar beyishshuva, kad nahir leillen, chashich leillen, leillen yemama, uleillen lelya. veit atar dechuleh yemama, vela ishtechach beh lelya, bar beshaata chada zeera. vehay deamar besifre kadmae, uvesifra deadam harishon hachi hu. dehachi ketiv, (Tehillim 139:14) odcha al ki noraot nifleti niflaim maasecha. uchetiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai. veal da, kolla shappir. veraza da itmesar lemarehon dechachmeta, vela limfalge techumin, begin deihu raza amika deorayyta.

Kegavvna da it beyamma. deit beh kama biryayn meshanyayn da min da. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25-26) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot sham oniyyot yehallechun livyatan vegomer. vecholla talyay da beda (vametakesharea da beda), vecholla kegavvna dilella. uvechullehu almin la shalta becholla bar adam, vekudesha berich hu aleh.

Ribbi nehoray sava parish leyamma rabba, veitregish yamma, veitavidu kol innun dahavo bearba, veitrechish leh nisa, venachat bishvilin yedian belibba deyamma, venafak techot yamma leyishuva chada, vechama meinnun biryayn, kullehu zeirin. vahavu metzalle tzelota, vela yada may ka amre. itrechish leh nisa, vesalik. amar, zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin setimin deraze illae. vavy leinnun deafligu al milehon vela mehemne.
Mehahu yoma, kad hava ate leve rav, veamre milleta deorayyta, hava bache. amre leh, amay ka bachit. amar lon, begin deavarna al mehemnuta demille derabbanan, umistafena middina dehahu alma.
(Bereshit 1:6) vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim. ribbi yehuda amar, ilmale hahu rekia deafrish ben mayin illae letattae, hava peligu bealma minnayyhu. aval
1053: Hay rakia, avid shelama benayyhu, vealma la mitkayyeyma ella al shalom. ta chazi, kudesha berich hu ikre shalom, hu shalom. ushemeh shalom, veitkeshshar kolla beshalom. ribbi abba amar, chamena dehay shema kaddisha illaa kolla hu shalom, vecholla chad. varchan mitparshan lehay sitra, ulehay sitra. (sefer acher kan chaser hatechalat hammaamar)

Yod dishma kaddisha itkeshar bitlat kishrin, begin da, hay 10, kotza chad leella, vekotza chad letatta, vechad beemtzaita. begin ditlat kishrin ishtelshalu (nusach acher itkeshsharu) ba chad kotza leella, kitra illaa, dehu illaa mikkol illain, resha dechol reshin, vehu kaim al kolla.

Chad kotza beemtzaita, dehu resha ochora. begin ditlat reshin havo, vechol chad vechad resha bilchodoy. veal da kotza deemtzaita, da hu resha ochora, denafik mikkotza dilella, vehu resha lechol shear reshin, leitbanaha shema kaddisha, vehay risha setima decholla.

Resha ochora tattaa, hu resha leashkaa leginta, vehu mabbua demayin, dechol netian ishtakyayn minneh. veda hu 10 bitlat kishrin. veal da shalshelet ikre. kehay shalshelet, deitkashar da beda, vecholla chad.

Tana besifra dachanoch, beshaata deachziu leh chachmeta derazin illain, vechama ilana deginta deeden, achziu leh chachmeta, beraza illaa. vechama, dechullehu almin havo mitkashsheran da beda, shail lon, al ma kayymin. amru leh, al 10 kayyme kullehu. minneh itbeniu vishtelshalu (nusach acher itberiu veishtachlalu). dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kulam bechachma asita. vechama, dechullehu mizdaazu middechilu demarehon, veal shemeh itkerun kullehu.
Uvesifra dishlomo malka amar, matun di bekatfura ditlata, dichlilan bekitfa degufeh. chad dechilu (sefer acher shelimu) decholla. chad satim shevilin. chad nahar amika.

Levatar parit beatvavn, (dealfa) beta beshachluleh yod hei. binyayna dechola. (chad satim shevilin. vechad nahar amika lechol) shelimu dishma kaddisha 10 resha decholla, av lecholla. 6 ben deolid venafik minneh. uminneh ishtechach 4, bat. matronita dechol dinin (sefer acher dayynin) bidaha ishtechachu temira bechullehu almin, (sefer acher illain nafkin, veillain vetattain) deillain nafkin, veillain vetattain minnah ittezanu. ha yod shelimu decholla, ushema kaddisha ishtachlal beh, vishtechach satim begavvih.

Levatar yod appik kolla, veshilshel kolla bekishshura chada, da beda. veha ukemeh butzina kaddisha, 10 appik hahu nahar, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. (davar acher 33 kegavvna) da Adonai, raza devina, vehi imma illaa.

Vehahu nahar, appik teren benin, kema deittemar. uminah ittezanu. levatar nafkin teren benin, uveratta itteznat mibben, da 6, ha ben hay malka dishlama kolla dileh, raza 804. ulevatar ishtechach Adonai, deittezzenat min 6. veha ukemeh. (sefer acher levatar nafkin teren bara uveratta 11 hay bara malka dishlama kolla dileh. vehay Adonai beratta ittezanat min 6 veha ukemuha) ishtechach, dey ikkara vesharsha ushelimu decholla. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit.

Tenan, 10 shemot ishtachlalu venafku mehay yod. 10 dehi asiraa deatvavn. vechullehu ail lon lehahu nahar kaddisha, kad itabbera. vaasara shemahan kullehu setimin bechad. vechullehu setimin bey. 10 kalil lon. 10 appik lon. hu av lecholla. av laavahan.

Minneh (sefer acher uveh yatvin) (beh asar tevin) nafku 10. remez laasara becheshbon. atvavn yod kalil lon 10, (saayved) shelimu decholla. 10: dechar venukeba. du karenan lon, teren. veal da adam du partzufin itbere, veinnun partzufin dechar venukeba havo, kegavvna dilella. 10 meella letatta. 10 mittatta leella. vecholla chad milla. 13 mechilan talyayn beh, veal da yod kalil 10 kema deittemar, veha ukemuha.
Vta chaze, 10 shemahan innun, lokovel 10 atvavn. uvesifra derav hamenuna sava temanya innun, uteren dargin, lokovel teren rekiin. umishtanyayn shemahan, asra, vetisha, utemanya, usheviaa.
Kadmaa 15, begin dey kalil Adonai. vaAdonai nafka min 10. begin kach chachma yah ikre.

Tinyayna Adonai (nusach acher Yahu) deikre elohim. begin dehahu nahar rachame, uvegin dedinin mitare minneh, (sefer acher 33) (elohim unefaku) atvavn derachame ketiv, venakud elohim. vela elohim dina.
1054: Telitaa, el. vehu gedula, vehu ikre hael haggadol. reviaa, elohim. dedinin beh itaran, vehu dina takkifa. chamishaa, Adonai. kelala dechol shelimu dimhemnuta, veda hu rachame bishlimu veda hu tiferet. shetitaa usheviaa, tzevaot ikrun.

Teminaa, el chay. kema deat amer (Tehillim 133:3) ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim vegomer. veda tzaddik, dechol chayyim nafkin mittamman, vikre Adonai. kema deat amer (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan. veda hi 6 zeera dishma kaddisha. begin kach vav vavin teren.

Teshiaa, adonay. veda malchut kaddisha, dedinin nafkin mittamman lealma. veda hu kitra batraa, dechullehu shemahan. veshem ehye, kelala usetima dekadmeta. veda hu kitra illaa, resha dechol reshin, shemeh satim vela itgalleyay, veittemar. uvesifra deaggadta, eser shemahan ketivan begavvna ochora vaana la tannena hachi.

Ribbi abba patach, (Shir HaShirim 4:16) uri tzafon uvoi teman hafichi ganni yizzelu vesamav yavo dodi leganno veyochal peri megadav. uri tzafon, illen olot denishchatot batztzafon, begin deinnun machshavot bitzfuni libba, uvaatar dedina. begin demachashava ishtechach belelya, bezimna dedina ishtechach. ruach tzafon menashva befalugeta delelya, kad mitare anshe, vechinnor dedavid menaggen meelav, umachashavtan divne nasha mitare.

Uvoi teman, illen shelamim denishchatin badarom, begin deinnun shelama decholla, shelama deilae udetattae. veillen shelimu (17 amud alef) desitre alma. shelimu decholla missitra dimhemnuta. ushelamim: begin deinnun shelama decholla. bealim achlin minnayyhu, umithanyayn minnayyhu. deha shelama hu leh, ulechol alma, bedarga chada. chataot vaashamot neechalin lechahane, begin deinnun zeminin lechappara alayyhu, uleabera chovayyhu. umikkol karbani la chavivin kame kudesha berich hu kemo shelamim, begin deishtechach shelama beillae vetattae.

Vella mekullehu ketoret, deihu shelim mikkolla, vela atya la al chet, vela al asham, vela al avon, ella al simcha. kema deat amer (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, veha ukemuha. veal da, ketoret la mitkarev ella bezimna deshemen mitkarev, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 30:7) vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim babboker babboker behetivo et hannirot yaktirenna. uchetiv, (Shemot 30:7-8) uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna. begin deishtechachu shemen uketoret kachada. ta chaze, shelamim becholla hu shelama. uketata vekitruga la itar bealma, aval ketoret, kashir keshiru dimhemnuta.

Ribbi elazar amar, kullehu asara shemahan ketive, vaanan tanenan. kadmaa, (65 amud alef) ehye, da setima illaa, keman deamar ana man daana, vela ityeyda man hu. levatar asher ehye, ana dezammin leitgalya, beinnun kitrin (acharanin), deha bekadmita satim, ulevatar share leitgalya, ad demate legilluya dishma (sefer acher dishlimu) kaddisha.

Vchacha ketiv bemoshe, ehye bekadmita, setimu decholla, ana hu man daana. levatar asher ehye, ana zammin leitgalya. levatar ehye batraa, veda kad imma mitabbera, vaadayin hu satim. ematay itgalleya. bezimna dichtiv, (Shemot 3:16) lech veasafta et zikne yisrael veamarta alehem Adonai elohe avotechem vegomer, da shelimu decholla, vehacha hu gilluya vekishshura dishma kaddisha.
Begin kach, kadmaa decholla, ehye. tinyayna, yah. begin dechachma appik Adonai, vesatim beh, vela itparsha lealmin minneh. veha ukemuha dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden kehay gavvna. 5.
Vehachi olifna meabba, 10 kema deittemar. levatar yah, dela mitparshan lealmin, 10 appik Adonai, kehay gavvna 5 hare 10. vehahu nahar denafik minneh.

Veitmeshach minneh uletatta, teren benin denafkin minnayyhu. missitra deabba 10, nafik ben, deha achid beh bey, veachid behahu nahar. umissitra deima nafkat bat, deihu (Shemot 210 amud alef) nahar tattaa, vehay ben itmeshach levatar vnafik minnayyhu,
1055: Vehu 6, veda yarit leabba uleimma, veitkeshar beh mehemnuta decholla. uminneh itteznat beratta, mehahu yeruta deihu yarit.

Val da bae lemichtav shema kaddisha, 10 bekadmita, kotza chad leella, vekotza chad beemtzaita, vekotza chad letatta, veha ittemar. levatar yah, dela mitparshan da min da lealmin, kegavvna da 5. begin deyishtechachu tarvvyyhu bishlimu decholla, av vaem ben uvat. kegavvna da 15 (sefer acher 11). hare lach kol shelimu dimhemnuta.

Levatar itpashat mehemnuta, venafkin teren benin mikkelala chad, bearchayyhu. ben nafik mittarvvyhu, vehu 6 dishma kaddisha. bat nafkat missitra deimma, vehi Adonai batraa dishma kaddisha. vela ishtelimat ella im 6, begin deminneh itteznat, veal da bae lemichtav 6, ulevatar Adonai, kegavvna da 5, hare 6 vehahu itpashshetuta denafik minneh, kegavvna dehahu nahar denafik min 10, begin deminneh itteznat. 6 hare ben denafik minneh letatta.

Vha millin illen okim lon abba, veha ittemaru. vaana kad matena lemillin illen, ema lon, begin defikdona deabba hachi. vehachi bae bar nash leizdahara bishma kaddisha, deyichtov shema kaddisha kegavvna da, veda ihu kadka chaze. vei lav, la ikre shema kaddisha veikre pagim. uman defagim shema kaddisha, tav leh dela itbere.

Telitaa, Adonai deikre elohim kema deittemar, rachame, venafik minneh dina. veda hu hahu nahar, denagid venafik meeden. reviaa, el gadol. veha ittemar, veda gedola. chamishaa, elohim. uvechol atar hu gevura. shetitaa, Adonai, rachame, shelimu decholla. ikkara decholla. kishra di mehemnuta. achid lechol sitrin. veda tiferet yisrael.

Sheviaa uteminaa tzevaot. veal da, Adonai kariv becholla. achid bechol sitrin, lezimnin Adonai elohim, deha kerivin innun tiferet legabbe gevura. lezimnin Adonai tzevaot, deha kerivin innun tiferet legabbe netzach vehod, deikrun tzevaot. veha ittemar deishtemodan mille nevie mehemni mippumayyhu. kad amre, ko amar Adonai elohim. vechad amri, ko amar Adonai tzevaot. vhavu yadin mean atar atyayn millin.

Teshiaa (nusach acher 31) shadday. deamar lealma day, deha day sippuka hu. vesippuka la ate lealma, ella min tzaddik, deihu yesod olam, deamar laolam day. asiraa, adonay. deha dina demalchuta dina vadday. vehay leaggacha keravin demalka bealma. veda gevura tattaa, veda ihu tzedek.

Veillen innun asara shemahan dekudesha berich hu ikre behu, mitkashsheran da beda, beyichuda shelim. veillen innun kitrin kaddishin demalka, dehu ishtemoda behu, veinnun shemeh, vehu innun. vechad mitkashsheran kullehu kachada, al recha diktoret, keden ikre ketoret, kishura demitkashsherin kachada. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyadin orchin deorayyta, veyadin leishtemoda bikara demarehon, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:18) uvau verau et chevodi.

(Vayikra 3:1) veim zevach shelamim karbano. rabbi shimon omer, ketiv (Bamidbar 7:86) asara asara hakkaf beshekel hakkodesh. asara asara lemay ka atya. ella, asara lemaase bereshit. vaasara lemattan tora. asara maamarot bemaase bereshit, vaasara maamarot bemattan tora. bemay ka mayyre. begin dealma la itbere ella begin orayyta, vechol zimna deyisrael mitaske beorayyta, alma mitkayyeyma. vechol zimna deyisrael mitbatle meorayyta, ma ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti.

Ta chaze, asara maamarot lemaase vereshit, keditnan baasara maamarot nivra haolam. asara maamarot lemattan tora, ellu aseret haddibberot. ketiv (Shemot 20) anochi Adonai elohecha. uchetiv bemaase bereshit (Bereshit 1:3) yehi or vayhi or. da mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu
1056: Or ikre, dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:1) Adonai ori veyishi mimmi ira vegomer.

Ketiv (Shemot 20:3) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. uchetiv bemaase berishit, (Bereshit 1:6) yehi rakia betoch hammayim vegomer. yehi rakia, illen yisrael, deinnun chulaka dekudesha berich hu, deachdin behahu atra deikre shamayim. vehayeynu raza, dezimna chada shaal ribbi yesa sava leribbi elay, amar, ha shear ammin yahav lon kudesha berich hu leravrevin memanan shallitin, yisrael bean atar yahav lon. shalach leh, vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim, veshappir shalach leh.

Betocha hammayim, ben millule orayyta. vyhi mavdil ben (Shemot 199) mayim lammayim, ben kudesha berich hu, deikre beer mayim chayyim. uven avoda zara, deikre (Yirmeyahu 2:13) borot nishbarim vegomer deinun mayim hammarim, mayim achurin, mechunasim, seruchim umetunafim. veal da yisrael kaddishin mavdilin ben mayim lamayim.

Ketiv (Shemot 20:7) la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, (Bereshit 1:9) yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad. ta chaze, kol man deome bishma kaddisha leshakra, keillu parish imma meatra leella. vechitrin kaddishin la mityayshve beduchetayyhu, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 16:28) venirgan mafrid alluf. veen alluf ella kudesha berich hu. uchetiv yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad, la teshave piruda, begin omaa deshikra. el makom echad, kadka chaze baatar dikshot, vela baatar ochora leshakra. umay shikra. hu deazlin mayya laatar ochora, delav ihu dileh.

Ketiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, tadshe haaretz deshe esev. ematay itreviat ara kaddisha veitatterat beitraha, havi omer beyom hashshabbat, deha keden itchabberat kalla (nusach acher matronita) bemalka, leappaka deshain uvirkan lealma.

Ketiv kabbed et avicha veet immecha. uchetiv bemaase berishit, yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim. may ka mayyre. ella illen meorot, da hu avicha veimmecha. avicha, da shimsha. immecha, da sihara. veen shimsha ella kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 84:12) ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim. velet sihara ella keneset yisrael, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:20) virechech lo yeasef, veal da kolla chad.

Ketiv lo tirtzach, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya, veant la tiktol bar nash, deikre hache, dichtiv vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya. vela tehvo kaddagim hallalu, deravreve bale lezutere.

Ketiv lo tinaf, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. mikkan olifna, dela yeshakker bar nash beintu ochora delav ihi bat zugeh. veal da ketiv, totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah, dela tolid itteta ella mimminah, uman ihu minnah, da ben zugah.
Ketiv lo tignov, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, vayomer elohim hinne natatti lachem et kol esev zorea zera, may deyahavit lechu veafkidat lechu yehe lechu, vela tignovu ma dehu meochora.

Ketiv lo taane vereacha ad shaker, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, vayyomer elohim naase adam betzalmenu. man dehu bediyyukena demalka, la tashid beh sheker. uman deashid sheker bechavreh, keillu ashid leella.
Ketiv lo tachmod eshet reecha, uchetiv bemaase bereshit, lo tov hyot haadam levaddo vegomer. ha bat zugach lokovlach, val da lo tachmod eshet reecha.

Vehayeynu asara maamarot lemaase bereshit, vaasara maamarot lemattan tora. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 7:86) asara asara hakkaf beshekel hakkodesh. ittekalu kachada beshikkula chada. uvegin kach kaim alma, vishtechach beh shelama. veal da, veim zevach shelamim karbano, lekayyeyma alma bishlama. velo od, ella dimchapper al mitzvot ase, veal mitzvot lo taase, begin leatla shalom al kolla.
Ketiv (Iyov 25:2) hameshel vafachad immo ose shalom bimromav, hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay. aval hameshel, da
1057: Avraham, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 23:6) nesi elohim atta betochenu, uchetiv (Bereshit 12:2) vaavarechcha vaagaddela shemecha. vafachad, da yitzchak. dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:42) ufachad yitzchak haya li. (Iyov 25:2) ose shalom bimromav, da yaakov. dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, uchetiv (Zecharya 8:19) vehaemet vehashalom ehavu. deemet veshalom kashir da beda. veal da hu shelemuta decholla.

Ushelamim shelemuta hu, ushelama decholla. uman deakriv shelamim asge shelama bealma. yaakov ihu avid shalom, kema deamaran. begin deachid lehay ulehay. ushelamim achidan bemitzvot ase, uvemitzvot lo taase, behay sitra, uvehay sitra. veal da ikre shelamim. veraza demilla, dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam: gevar shelim. shelim leella, ushelim letatta. davar acher (Iyov 25) hameshel da michael. vafachad da gavriel. da yesoda dileh mimmayya veda yesoda dileh meeshsha vekudesha berich hu avid shelama benayyhu dichtiv, (Iyov 25:2) ose shalom bimromav.

Ribbi acha amar, ketiv (Vayikra 7:12) im al toda yakrivennu vehikriv al zevach hattoda vegomer. may ka mayyre. kema deat amer, (Vayikra Adonai:Adonai) vehitvda asher chata aleha, aleha dayyka. veal da challot matztzot vegomer. vechallot matztzot, ha ukemuha, veal ma atya. matztzot vechallot ketiv chaser, begin dechata aleha.

Tane ribbi chiyyay, ketiv al zevach todat shelamav, da shelimu decholla. shelamav: tere. toda, ityeyda. amar leh ribbi yehuda, toda yedia, shelamav mahu tere. amar leh, teren vavin, vav dehayynu shelamav, shelama decholla.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, todat shelamav, deatil shelama becholla, veittear rachame bechullehu almin. todat shelamav, ribbi yose amar, ha deamar ribbi chiyyay shappir, dekneset yisrael itbarcha meinnun tere, deinnun shelama decholla. ribbi yose amar, lechem chametz ha yedia, veha ittemar kema dehava chattaa, kach hava mekarev behahu gevavna mammash.

Ta chaze, challot matztzot chaser, kema deittemar belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen. lemay ka remiza. (Shemot 223 amud alef) amar ribbi shimon, hane innun (Bereshit 3:24) lahat hacherev hammithappechet vegomer. begin dechullehu itmanan al archayyhu divne nasha, al innun deavrin al pikkude orayyta, veal da kolla solet belula vashshemen, leamshacha meshach revut meatar illaa letatta, veyitbarchun kullehu kachada, mehahu meshach revut kudesha.

Vda hu yayin lannesech, veha okimna reviit hahin. vaatar chad (sefer acher tale) malle yayin veshemen umayim lenissuch, veha okimna mille, mayim leashkaa ginta, vechol innun netian. veal da, it mayim veit mayim. yayin, it atar deihu tov, veit atar deihu leanesha deihu dina.

Al da, man dechame yayin bechelmeh, it leman deihu tav, veit leman deihu dina. i talmid chacham hu, ketiv (Tehillim 104:15) vyayin yesammach levav enosh. uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 1:2) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, veda hu yayin demintere, dechadde lecholla. vei la, (Mishlei 31:6) tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh. it yayin ochora deihu dina. veal da, yeot lekarva illen millin bekarbaneh, begin deyitabbar dina, veyittear rachame. abar yayin, vayyte yayin, vechen becholla.

Veshemen la ade mikarbane lealmin, bar mimminchat kenaot dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:15) lo yitztzok alav shemen vegomer. deha hacha la baya rachame, deha kolla dina, dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:27) vetzavta bitnah venafla yerechah. uchetiv (Bamidbar Adonai:29) yitten Adonai vegomer, veal da vezot torat zevach hashshelamim im al toda yakrivennu.

Ribbi chizkiyya hava yativ kameh deribbi yitzchak, kamu befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta. patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Tehillim 134:1) hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer, hay kera ha ukemuha chavrayyay, veha ittemar. aval hay shevacha hu dechol innun beni mehemnuta. uman innun bene mehemnuta. innun demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin leyachada shema kaddisha kadka yeot. ushevacha deinnun bene mehemnuta, innun dekayymin befalgu lelya lemile
1058: Beorayyta umitdabbeke bah bichneset yisrael, leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu bemille deorayyta.

Ta chaze, beshaata devar nash kam befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta, veruach tzafon ittear befalgut lelya, hahi ayyalta kayyeyma umeshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu. uveshaata dehi kayyeyma, kama elef, vechamma ribbevan, kayymin immah bekiyyumayyhu, vechullehu sharan leshabbecha lemalka kaddisha.

Hahu man dezache vekam befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta, kudesha berich hu atzit leh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini. vechol innun ochlosin leella, vechol beni tushebachta dimzamrin lemarehon, kullehu mishtachche begin tushebachta deinnun delau beorayyta, umachrezi veamre, (Tehillim 134:1) hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai. attun barchu et Adonai. attun shabbachu lemalka kaddisha attun aatteru leh lemalka.

Vehahi ayyaylta mitattera beh behahu bar nash, vekamat kame malka, veamrat chame bemay bera atena lekammach, bemay bera ittearna legabbach, uman innun dishvacha kolla dilhon kamme malka. hadar veamar, haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot. illen ikrun avde Adonai, illen itchazun levarcha lemalka. uvircheta dilhon birchata, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 134:2) seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai vegomer. attun itchazun demalka kaddisha yitberach al yadayychu uvircheta deal yadayychu birchata hi.

Seu yedechem kodesh. mahu kodesh. atar illaa, demabbua denachala amika nafik minneh. dichtiv, venahar yotze meeden lehashekot. veeden hu deikre kodesh illaa, begin kach seu yedechem kodesh. uvar nash deavid ken, vezache lehay, may ka machreze aleh. yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, at tevarech lekudesha berich hu, meatar deikre kodesh illaa. vehu yevarech lach meatar deikre tziyyon, deat umatronita titbarchun kachada.

Kema deziuuga dilchon hava kachada leshabbecha lemalka. kach mehahu atar demitbarcha keneset yisrael, mehahu atar yazmin lach birchan, hada hu dichtiv yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalam. man hu tuv yerushala 40. innun birchan denafka lah mimmalka, al yede dehahu darga kaddisha detzaddik. val da, yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalam, vecholla chad milla.

Uree vanim levanycha vegomer, uree vanim levanecha shappir, mahu shalom al yisrael, may ka bae hacha al yisrael. ella, begin deasge shelama leella, dechad hu zache lechule hay, asge shelama leella vetatta. shalom al yisrael, setam. veshalom shevacha hu deilae vetattae, shevacha hu dechol almin. umille deorayyta asgiu shelama bealma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarich et ammo bashalom.

(Vayikra 4:2) nefesh ki techota. ribbi yose patach, (Shir HaShirim 2:17) ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim vegomer, kama it lehu livni nasha leizdahara mechovehon, dela lemechote kame marehon, deha bechol yoma veyoma karoza nafik vekare, attearu beni alma libbayychu lekame malka kaddisha. attearu leizdahara mechovayychu. attearu nishmeta kaddisha deyahav begavvyychu meatar kaddisha illaa.

Detanenan, beshaata dekudesha berich hu appik nishmeta lenachta bivne nasha, ashid bah bechamma yiudin, bechamma kastorin, begin lenatra pikkudoy. velo od ella deabar lah beelef utemanya almin leishtashea, ulemechome behu yekara deinnun demishtaddele beorayyta. (nafka) vekayyeyma kame malka bilvush yekar, bediyyukena dehay alma, bilvush yekar illaa istekalat bikara demalka kol yoma, veattar lah bechamma itrin.
Beshaata demate zimna lenachta lealma, avdat madoraha beginta deeden deara telatin yomin, lemechome yekara demarehon detzaddikayyay, vesalleka leatraha leella, uvatar da nachtat lealma,
1059: Attar lah malka kaddisha, beshva itrin, ad deatat vealat bego gufa debar nash. vechad ihi begufa debar nash, vechavat behay alma, veishtaddelat bachashochaha. orayyta tavvha ala, veamrat, uma kol yekara da, vechol ashlemuta ashlim lenafshata malka illaa, vehi chavaat kameh, nefesh ki techota, ma din hu detechota.

Amar ribbi yose, nefesh ki techota ahadarna likkera ad sheyyafuach hayyom, eta lehay nefesh leizdahara mechovaha, vetituv leitdakkea, ad sheyyafuach hayyom, ad shello yafuach yoma dehay alma, veyete hahu yoma takkifa, deyitba lah malka dina, lenafka mehay alma. venasu hatztzelalim, da hu raza ben chavrayyay deka amre, divshaata demate zimna debar nash lenafka min alma, tzulema devar nash itabbar minneh, hada hu dichtiv ad sheyyafuach hayyom, ad dela yinshof yoma lenafka mehay alma. venasu hatztzelalim, deitavar tzulema, yetuv kame mareh.

Ribbi elazar amar, teren tzulemin it leh lebar nash kad ihu bekiyyumeh, chad ravreva, vechad zeera, dichtiv hatztzelalim, tere. vechad mishtakkeche kachada, keden hu bar nash bekiyyumeh. veal da, venasu hatztzelalim ketiv. keden bae bar nash leistakkela beovadoy, uletakkena lon kame mareh, veyode alayyhu. begin dekudesha berich hu ikre rachum vechannun, umekabbel leinnun detavin kameh.

Veda hu ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim, dechevan deinnun tzelalim mitabberan minneh, veihu tafis bekolara, teshuva hi aval la mealya kol kach kezimna dekaim ihu bekiyyumeh. ushelomo malka achriz veamar, (Kohelet 12:1) uzechor et borecha bime bechurotecha ad asher lo yavou yeme haraa vegomer.

Val da ad sheyyafuach hayyom, devae bar nash leatkena ovadoy. dechad matun yomoy leistalleka min alma, kudesha berich hu tohe aleh, veomer, venefesh ki techota veshama kol ala, veha omena lah beomaa dishmi dela leshakkera bi, vashadit bah kad nachtat lealma, vehu ed vadday, mikkamma zimnin deashadit bah, lenatra pikkuday. begin kach hoil ubbar nash hu ed, beshaata deyetuv kame malka, o raa o yada. o raa, innun chovin deavad veistekal behu. o yada bevirura demilla deavar al pikkuda demareh, im lo yaggid, im la yode alayyhu kame mareh (45 ketiv) kad yippuk mehay alma, venasa avono. vechad yissa avono, heach patchin leh pitcha, veheach yekum kame mareh, veal da nefesh ki techota ketiv.

(Vayikra 4:2) nefesh ki techota. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 44:18) kol zot baatnu velo shechachanucha velo shikkarnu bivritecha. kol zot baatnu, kol ellu bau alenu mibbae leh. ella kol dinin dilella atu alana. vela shechachanucha, vela anshena millule orayytach. mikkan olifna, kol man deanshe millule orayyta, vela bae lemile bah, keillu anshe lekudesha berich hu, deha orayyta kullah shema dekudesha berich hu havi.

Vlo shikkarnu bivritecha, dechol man dimshakker beh behay at kayyayma kaddisha derashim beh, keillu meshakker bishma demalka, begin dishma demalka itreshim beh bevar nash. ukera ochora ode beh behay kera, dichtiv, (Tehillim 44:21) im shachachnu shem elohenu vannifros kappenu leel zar. im shachachnu shem elohenu, kema deat amer velo shechachanucha (veda hi orayyta deihu sham elohenu). vannifros kappenu leel zar, kema deat amer, velo shikkarnu bivritecha. vecholla chad milla. may shikra hacha. defaris kappav lirshuta ochora, umeshakker behay berit. veal da orayyta achidat behay, dechol man denatir hay berit, keillu natir orayyta kullah, uman dimshakker behay, keillu meshakker beorayyta kullah.

Ta chazi, avraham ad la itgezar, ha la ittemar deihu natir orayyta, kevn deitgezar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 26:5) ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukkotay vetorotay. vecholla begin deitgezar, itreshim beh reshima kaddisha, venatir leh kedka yeot, salik leh keillu natar orayyta kullah. yitzchak
1060: Uf hachi ketiv, (Bereshit 17:21) veet beriti akim et yitzchak. veal da orayyta ikre berit.

Ta chaze, yosef begin denatar leh lehay berit, vela baa leshakkera beh, zacha likara behay alma, velikara lealma deate. velo od, ella dekudesha berich hu ashre shemeh begavih, dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo. vezacha levirchata dehay alma, ulevirchata dealma deate.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro hadar lo vegomer. yosef begin denatir lehay berit, zacha beshor, deihu kadmaa lekarbena. amar leh ribbi yehuda, i hachi amay itberach bemilla deihi semala, bimina mibbae leh, deha ketiv (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol. amar leh begin deyagin al chove deyaravam.

Amar leh, raza olifna behay kera, dechevan deyosef natar leh lehay berit, dehay berit achid bitren dargin, veinnun teren dargin leella, bishmahan itkerun. veolifna befarashat para adumma, dehay para chad darga meinnun teren dargin illain havi, veziuuga defara shor ikre, veda hu bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav hadar lo vday. velav hay keshor dealma, ella vekarne reem karnav. karna illaa hu al kol ochoranin, veal da bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse aretz.

Amar ribbi abba, mashma, dechol man denatir lehay at reshima kaddisha, innun teren dargin illain itkashsheran beh. lenatra leh becholla, uleattera leh bikara illaa. veal da zacha bitren (lecha lecha 93) malchu. chad hu. vechad beno. dechevan dishlomo malka itdebak bennashim nachriyyot, ityeyhiv malchuta leyaravam, val da berit chaviv mikkolla.

Begin kach amar ribbi shimon, hay bar nash deolid bar, itkeshshar bishchinta, dehi pitcha dechol pitchin (sefer acher vehay ravya deitgezar itkeshar bishchinta, dehi pitcha dechol kitrin) illain, pitcha deitkeshshar bishma kaddisha. (deamar rabbi shimon) vehahu dama denafik mehahu ravya, natir kame kudesha berich hu, uveshaata dedinin mitarin bealma, ashgach kudesha berich hu behahu dama, vesheziv alma. uvegin kach ketiv (Bereshit 17:12) uven shemonat yamim yimmol lachem kol zachar. uchetiv (Tehillim 90:10) veim bigvurot shemonim shana. vecholla bechad matkela salleka.

Tana behahu dama, zache alma leitbassema bechesed, vekayymin kullehu almin, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz vegomer. im lo veriti tinach. yomam valayla lamma.

Amar ribbi shimon, tanenan teren kitrin itachadan kachada, veinnun pitcha dechol shear kitrin, vetana, chad dina, vechad rachame, umitbasseman da beda, dechar venukeba. (sefer acher vetana chad dechar vechad nukeba, chad dina, vechad rachame) besitra didchura sharya chesed. (lecha lecha 94) besitra denukeba sharya dina. (uvegin kach) chad chivvavra vechad sumaka. uvegin leitbassema da beda, (begin kach) mitkashsheran da beda. vehay berit achid behu beyomam valayla, bedina vechesed. bedina bekadmita. ulevatar sharya beh bechesed, veitbesam becholla. veda hu berit deikre yomam valayla, deachid betarvavyyhu.

Uman dezache lenatra lehay berit kedka yeot, vela chate beh kol yomoy, achid behu beyomam valayla. vezache litren almin, alma da vealma deate. veal da ikre avraham shelim, dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim, veematay ikre shelim. kad zacha betarvavyyhu, beyomam valayla. dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. vetarvvyyhu achasin avraham. vela itkayyeyma beh chesed bekiyyuma shelim, ad deitgezar. kevan deitgezar, itkayyaym beh, vzacha letarvvyyeyhu, veikre shelim.

Kema detanenan dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:1) vehu yoshev petach haohel kechom hayyom. petach haohel, da hu kitra asiraa demalka, deihu pitcha lechol mashkena kaddisha dishar kitrin, vkaryih david malka (lehay) pitcha (nusach acher tzedek), dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek, uchetiv ze hashshaar laAdonai. kechom hayyom. kad nahara nehiru dechesed, chulak adbeh, kema deyativ behay, yativ behay. ematay itkayyaymu beh, kad itgezar. uvegin kach ikre berit yomam valayla. tana ketiv, (Shemot 12:23) ufasach Adonai al happetach. may ufasach Adonai al happetach. desharya al hay pitcha chesed, leitbassema. uvegine kach velo yitten hammashchit vegomer.
Amar ribbi elazar, ha tanenan, giyyora kad itgezar veayil techot gadpe dishchinta, ikre ger tzedek vela yattir, ger tzedek vday, zache lemeal behahu
1061: Kitra detzedek veat amart yomam valayla dezachu letarvavyyeyhu.

Amar leh rabbi shimon, elazar beri, la dame man deate misharsha kaddisha, umiggiza dikshot, leman deate miggiza bisha, umisharsha degaale bishin takkifin. beyisrael ketiv behu, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek kullo zera emet. beumot ovde avoda zara ketiv (Yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam.

Uvegin kach, yisrael kaddishin zara dikshot, giza deitbesamu betura desinay, veitpesak minnayyhu kol zuhama, kullehu mitvassemin, vechullehu ayyle bekayayma kaddisha deyomam valayla, lemehevi shelemim becholla. aval beumot ovde avoda zara, kashya lemebar minnayyhu zuhama, vaafillu ad 3 darin. uvegin kach ger tzedek. vday.

Deamar rav hamenuna sava, umot ovde avoda zara, ad la itgezaru sharyayn bechitrin tattain dela kaddishin, veruach misava sharya alayyhu. kevan deitgeyayru veitgezaru, sharyayn bechitra kaddisha (330 shechinta) desharya al shear kitrin tattain, verucha kaddisha sharya alayyhu. aval yisrael, kaddishin bene kaddishin, degizin vesharashin, veitbesamu betura desinay, vealu bimhemnuta shelemata kaddisha. beshaata deitgezar sharya becholla, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

(Vayikra Adonai:23) vehaya ki yechota veashem veheshiv et haggezela vegomer. ribbi yose amar, (Yeshayahu 54:9) ki me noach zot li asher nishbati meavor me noach. hay kera kashya, ketiv (bareasheytez) ume hammabbul hayu al haaretz. uchetiv (Bereshit 9:11) velo yikkaret kol basar od mimme hammabbul. me hammabbul ketiv, vela me noach, vehacha ketiv ki me noach zot li. zot li, hem li mibbae leh.

Ella hachi tana, kad zakkain segiu bealma, kudesha berich hu chadde umishtebach behu. detanenan kad share zakkaa bealma, veishtechach beh, kivyachol attil shelama bealma, vechol alma mitbarcha begineh, veattil shelama befamalya shel maala. mena lan. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 27:5) o yachazek bemauzzi yaase shalom li shalom yaase li. teren shelamin amay hacha. ella yaase shalom li, deashre dechar venukeba. shalom yaase li, demitbarchan avahan.

May ikka benayyhu, amar ribbi yose, kad mitbarchan avahan, shalom yaase li, deakdim shelama becholla. uvegin kach shalom kadim. yaase shalom li, may taama la akdim shalom hacha. ella begin deyitaver chivya desharya benukeba bekadmita, veyete dechura lemishre beatreh, uvegin kach yaase akdim, ulevatar shalom. (Vayikra 81 amud bet vesham matechaylazeh hammaamar)
Tana bezimna dezakkaa share bealma, dinin la mitarin, vela shaltin bealma, mishshum dehahu bar nash zakkaa hu ot bealma, vekudesha berich hu bae bikareh, vealma mitkayyem begineh.

Tanya amar ribbi yose, bezimna divni alma ishtechachu chayyayvin kame kudesha berich hu, hahu zakkaa deishtechach bealma, (bae) kudesha berich hu ishtae bahadde, begin deyive rachamin al alma, veyitpayes bahadayyhu. me aved kudesha berich hu, ishtae bahadeh al innun chayyayve alma. amar leh leotava leh bilchodoy, uleshetzaa lechullehu. ma archeh dehahu bar nash zakkaa. shavik dideh, venasiv lidkule alma bedil deyitpeyays kudesha berich hu bahadayyhu.

Mena lan. mimmoshe. deamar leh kudesha berich hu, chavu yisrael, (Shemot 32:8) asu lahem egel massecha veyishtachavu lo vegomer tu amar leh, heref mimmenni veashmidem vegomer, behay shaata amar moshe i begin yekara didi yishtetzun yisrael mealma, tav li mota, vela yemrun deshavikna hay dechule alma, begin yekara dili. miyyad vaychal moshe et pene Adonai elohav. veoshit garmeh lammita bechamma atre beginehon deyisrael, dichtiv veatta im tissa chattatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha vegomer. vetana, la zaz moshe mittamman, ad demachal kudesha berich hu leyisrael, hada hu dichtiv vyynnachem Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot leammo. uchetiv (Bamidbar 14:20) vayyomer Adonai salachti kidvarecha.
