Veillu benoach ketiv, (Bereshit 6:13) vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kol basar ba
1062: Lefanay vegomer. amar leh noach, veli ma at avid. amar leh vahakimoti et beriti ittach vegomer ase lecha tevat atze gofer. vela baa rachame al alma, unechitu mayya, veovidu bene alma, uvegin kach me noach ketiv. me noach vday, deveh havo talyayn, dela baa rachame al alma.

Mikkan amar ribbi yose, may dichtiv, (bareasheytet) vayyachel noach ish haadama. vyyachel: kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 30:3) lo yachel devaro, deitavid chol. ish haadama, divgineh ishtetziu bene alma, dela baa rachame alayyhu. davar acher ish (Bereshit 58 amud bet) haadama, divgineh itkeyyaymat levatar deishtetziu kadmae, dichtiv lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam vegomer.

Tana me noach ikrun, dehu garim deikrun al shemeh. amar ribbi yose, zot li may ka mayyre. ella amar kudesha berich hu, me noach garmu li, deaggele zot bealma. dichtiv vaani zot beriti otam. zot ot habberit vegomer. et kashti natatti beanan. kelomar let man deashgach ella likara dishmi dirmiza bezot. uman garim leh, me noach.

Mikkan simana lachasida zakkaa, dela itgalyay hay keshet beyomoy, vela itzterich alma beyomoy lehay (zot) ot. uman ihu. hahu devae rachame al alma, veitchazze leaggana aloy. kegon ribbi shimon ben yochay, dela itzterich alma beyomoy lehay ot, deha hu ot simana bealma hava.

Dela hava gezera deitgezar al alma leella, dela mevattel lah. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shmuel bakeg) moshel baadam, kudesha berich hu moshel baadam. umi moshel bekudesha berich hu kivyachol. tzaddik. dekudesha berich hu gazir, veihu mevattel.

Kegon rabbi shimon ben yochay, deyoma chad hava yativ abbava detara (nusach acher dimarta) delud, zakaf enoy, chaza shimsha denahir, veastim nehora 3 zimnin, addehachi itchashach nehora, veitchazze beh beshimsha uchama viroka. amar leh leribbi elazar bereh, ta avatray beri, venechome deha vadday gezera itgezar leella, vekudesha berich hu bae leodaa li, devadday telatin yomin talya hahu milleta deitgezar leella. vela avid kudesha berich hu, ad deodeh letzaddikayyay, hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 3:7) ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim.

Ad dahavo azle alu behahu kerem. chamu chad chivya dehava ate, ufumeh peticha (nusach acher vahava lachish belishshaneh), umelahata beara beafra. ishtenik rabbi shimon, vekatfar yedoy beresheh dechivya, shachich chivya, maich pumeh. vechama lishanih marchish. amar leh chivya chivya, zil veema lehahu chivya illaa, deha rabbi shimon ben yochay bealma shechiach. ayyleh leresheh lechad nukeba deafra. amar gozer ana, keshem detattaa itchazar lenukeba deafra, ken illaa yitchazer lenukeba dithoma rabba.

Rachish rabbi shimon bitzlota, ad dahavo metzalle shamu chad kala, putekra dekitfa ulu leatrayychu, katfira devureyayne la sharan bealma, deha, rabbi shimon ben yochay batil lon. zakkaa ant rabbi shimon, demarach bae bikarach al kol bene alma. bemoshe ketiv (Shemot lak) vaychal moshe vegomer, demashma deachid leh pargoda, veant rabbi shimon gozer, vekudesha berich hu mekayyem. hu gozer, veant mevattel.

Adhachi chama denahir shimsha, veitavar hahu uchama, amar rabbi shimon, vday ha alma itbessam, al leveteh vedarash, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot (Bereshit 23 amud alef) ahev yashar yechozu fanimo. may tama ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev, mishshum deyashar yechozu fanemo. may fanimo. panim illain divne alma, baun lemibbae rachame minneh, al kol ma deitzterichan.

Amar leh ribbi elazar bereh, i hachi yashar yechoze fanemo mibbae leh, o yesharim yechozu, may yashar yechozu. amar leh raza illaa, deinnun (132) yeme kodam deattika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. vime olam, dizer anpin, deinnun ikrun fanimo, (deinnun) chaman beorach meshar ma deitzterich lemechome.

Detana beshaata dekudesha berich hu ashgach bealma, vechama demitkashran ovadehon divni nasha letatta, itgalleyay attika kaddisha bizer anpin, umistakkelan kol innun anpin beanpin setimin, umitbarchan kullehu. may tama mitbarchan. mishshum demistakkelin illen beillen beorach meshar, dela satu limina vlismala, hada hu dichtiv
1063: Yashar yechozu fanemo. umitbarchan kullehu, umeshakyayn da leda, ad deitbarchan kullehu almayya. umishtachche kullehu almin kechad, ucheden itkere (Zecharya 14) Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Vchad chove alma segiu, astim attika kaddisha, vela mashgichin anpin beanpin, ucheden dinin mitare bealma, vechorsavavn remiu, veattik yomin astim, vela itgalleyay. hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 7:9) chaze havit ad di chorsavavn remiu veattik yomin yetiv. ad di chorsavavn remiu, deinnun kitrin illain, dimshakyayn lechullehu ochoranin, leukume bekiyyumayyhu. uman innun. avahan. veattik yomin yetiv, vela itgalleyay. ucheden mehappechin chayyayve alma rachame ledina.

Tana. missitra deimma, nafkin gardinin nimusin kelifin, veachadin bekulefoy digvura, shaltin al rachame, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 16) hannoadim al Adonai, al Adonai mammash. ucheden ishtechachu almin chaserin, (sefer acher ketirin) dela shelemin, uketatuta itar bechullehu.

Vchad beni alma machsherin ovadehon letatta, mitbasseman dinin, umitavran, umitare rachame veshaltan al hahu bisha deittear min dina kashya. vechad mitaran rachame, chedva venichumin mishtakkechin, mishshum deshalitin al hahu bisha. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 32:14) vyyinnachem Adonai al haraa. vayyinnachem mishshum (deshalta al haraa) deitkafya dina kashya, veshaltin rachame.

Tana, beshaata demitbasseman dinin, veshaltin rachame, kol kitra vechitra tav bekiyyumeh, umitbarchan kullehu kachada. vechad tayyvin kol chad vechad leatreh, umitbarchan kullehu kachada, umitbassema imma bekaldite gelifin vetayyvin lesitraha, keden ikre teshuva shelema, veitkappar alma, deha imma bechedvavta shelemata yatva, dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha, ucheden itkere yom hakkippurim, dichtiv beh (Vayikra 16:30) letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem. umitpatchin 50 tarin desitrin gelifin.

Tana, ketiv vehaya ki yechota veashem, mahu ki yechota, ulevassof veashem. ella hachi tana, ki yechota meinnun chovin deikrun chet, dichtiv mikkol chataot haadam. veashem: kema deat amer (Bamidbar Adonai:8) haasham hammushav laAdonai. veashem: vitakken, kelomar im yetakken ovadoy, veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal. amar ribbi yose mimmashma dichtiv veheshiv, vyashiv la ketiv ella veheshiv, veheshiv dayyka.

Tanya, bearba tekufin deshatta, kala itpesak, vedinin mitarin, uteshuva talya ad deittekan. vechad dinin mitarin, kala nafik, ved zavvyayn (sefer acher zimnin) dealma, sallekin venachtin. karoza kare, velet man deyishgach veyittear. vekudesha berich hu zammin, im yetuvun yetuv, vei lav, (kolla sefer acher kala) itpesak, vedinaya itavidu ucheden itkere vayyitatztzev, vyyitatztzev bevatte baray.

Amar ribbi yehuda, tanenan, min yoma deitcharav bi makdesha, let yoma dela ishtechach beh ritcha bisha. may tama. mishshum detanenan, amar ribbi yudai amar ribbi yesa, nishba hakkadosh baruch hu shelo yikkanes biyrushalam dilella, ad sheyyikkansu yisrael biyrushala 40 diltatta. uvegin kach, ritcha ishtechachat bealma.

Amar ribbi yose, (Vayikra 18:7) ketiv ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle. uchetiv, immecha hi lo tegalle ervatah. vetanenan immecha hi vadday. ha im gilla eryaytah, leman bae leatava lah, vday letakkena. may degalle.
Detanya kad sagya yitzra bisha bebar nash, la saggi ella beinnun eryayn, vechullehu chove achidan behahu erya. uchetiv lo tegalle. kad ittakkan, ittakkan lokovel hahu degalle, vda ikre teshuva.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kol chove alma achidan (sefer acher da) beda, ad deimma itgalya beginehon. vechad ihi itgalya, kol innun benin itgalleyayn (beginah). uchetiv (Devarim 22:6) lo tikkach haem al habbanim. vechad ittakkan alma letatta, ittakkan kolla, ad desalleka tikkuna leimma kaddisha, umittakna, veitkasseya mimma deitgalya. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 32:1) ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa, ucheden ikre teshuva, teshuva vadday. ucheden yom hakkippurim itkere, kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:30) mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu.
1064: Yehuda ematay itkere teshuva. kad imma mitkasya vekayyeyma bechedva al benin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha. vetavat bekiyyuma uman dehava sagir, tav leatreh. vechullehu tavin chad lechad, umitbarchan kol chad vechad, ucheden itkere teshuva (shelemata), teshuva setam leachlela kolla.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kad mitkeshar alma, kuleh mitkeshar kachada. ketiv (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha. meal shamayim, desalleka leella meatar deikre shamayim. umay ihu. da ihi imma. vehayeynu deikre teshuva.

Ribbi yehuda amar, dayyka dichtiv meal shamayim. ilmale ketiv al shamayim, mashma hahu atar dekayyeyma al shamayim, vela yattir. kevan deamar meal shamayim, mashma hahu atar dekayyeyma al hashshamayim leella leella. (sefer acher umay ihi ema, vehayeynu deikre teshuva.)

Detana, behahu zimna demitkashran ovadin letatta, veimma bechedvavta, itgalleya attika kaddisha, vetav nehora lizer anpin, ucheden kolla bechedvavta, kolla bishlimu, kolla ishtechachu bevirkan, verachamin zimnin, vealmin kullehu bechedvavta, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) yashuv yerachamenu yichbosh avonotenu. man yashuv. yashuv attika kaddisha leitgalyay bizera, yashuv leitgalyay dehava satim bekadmita, vecholla itkere teshuva.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kolla bichlal, kolla setam. uchetiv (Devarim 13:18) lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo venatan lecha rachamim. amar ribbi yitzchak, kolla hu vadday, veha okimna mille kammeh derabbi shimon.

Vheshiv et haggezela, tamman shailu chavrayyay, mippene ma bigzela ketiv, veheshiv et haggezela vela yattir. ella ha okimna, da shavvi dechilu illaa ketattaa. veda deganiv, shavvi dechilu tattaa lokovleh, vela dechilu illaa.

Ma ketiv leella, nefesh ki techota. (13 amud bet) kidkaamaran, deorayyta vekudesha berich hu tavvevhin aleh, veamre nefesh ki techota vegomer. uchetiv nefesh ki timol maal vegomer. o nefesh ki tishshava vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak, nefesh ketiv, vela ruach, vela neshama. vhacha gufa (sefer acher rucha) venefesh. dichtiv, vehaya ki yechota veashem veheshiv et haggezela. man devae letakkena ovadoy, kema deamaran veheshiv. man veheshiv, ella keman ditakken ovadin, begin deyativ mabbue mayya leatrayyhu, leashkaa netian, deha hu garim bechovoy leitmana minnayyhu. veal da veheshiv et haggezela vegomer. kema deittemar. (ad kan)

Ribbi abba hava yativ kameh derabbi shimon, al ribbi elazar bereh, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Tehillim 92:13) tzaddik kattamar yifrach vegomer. tzaddik kattamar, may kattamar. deha mikkol ilane alma let demitakkev leafrecha, kemo tamar. desalik leshivin shenin. may tama kattamar. ella af al gav dikra ashid, chavrayyay kullehu la bau legallaa.

Aval tzaddik kattamar yifrach, al galuta devavel ittemar, deha la tavat shechinta leatraha, ella besof shivin shenin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 29:10) ki lefi melot levavel shivim shana efkod etchem. veda hu tzaddik kattamar yifrach, desalik dechar venukeba leshivin shenin. tzaddik: da kudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev. uchetiv, (Shemot 9) Adonai hatztzaddik. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov.

Keerz ballevanon yisge, mahu erez. da kudesha berich hu. dichtiv, bachur kaarazim. (sefer acher deyativ al kurisaya deyaakov shelema) ballevanon yisge, ballevanon vadday, veda hu eden dilella, dealeh ketiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha. vehay erez, behahu atar illaa, yisge.

Vda begaluta batraa hu kehay erez, deitakkav lesallekaa. umishshata, desalik ad dekaim bekiyyumeh, hu yoma. veshiruta deyoma acharina, ad deavid tzel binhora dimama. veerez la salik, ella beidduna demayya. kema deat amer (Bamidbar 24:6) kaarazim ale mayim. kach erez ballevanon yisge. demittamman nafik mabbua venahara demayya, leashkaa. verez, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) bachur kaarazim.

Shetulim bevet Adonai, lezimna demalka meshicha. bechatzrot elohenu yafrichu, bitchiyyayt hammetim. od yenuvun beseva, behahu yoma deyishtechach alma charuv. deshenim veraanannim yihyu, levatar dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:22) hashshamayim hachadashim vhaaretz hachadasha, ucheden (tehillim 104) yismach Adonai bemaasav ketiv. vekol kach
1065: Lamma (Tehillim 92:16) lehaggid ki yashar Adonai tzuri velo avlata bo.

Tu patach veamar, (Mishlei 16:28-29) ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon venirgan mafrid alluf. ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon, kema deamaran, chayyayvayya avde pegimu leella. venirgan mafrid alluf, mafrid alufo shel olam, veda kudesha berich hu.

Davar acher ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon. mahu yeshallach. yeshallach leinnun netian. madon: deyankan missitra dedina. venirgan mafrid alluf, kema deamaran, chayyayvayya avdin pegimu leella. mafrid: deyichuda la ishtechach, mafrid, lematronita mimmalka. ulemalka mimmatronita. uvegin kach la ikre echad, deechad la ikre, ella kad innun beziuuga chada. vavy leinnun chayyayvayya deavdin piruda leella. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deinnun mekayyman kiuma dilella, vezakkain innun marehon ditshuva detayyvin kolla leatrayyhu.

Veal da tanenan, atar devaale teshuva yatve, tzaddikim gemurim la yatve beh. may tama. ella innun ittakanu baatar illaa, baatar deshakyu deginta mishtechach mittamman. veda hu teshuva. veal da ikrun baale teshuva. veillen ittakanu baatar ochora, deikre tzaddik.

Veal da illen yatvin baatar illaa, veillen yatvin baatar zutera. may tama. illen tayyvin mayya leatrayyhu, meatar illaa denahara amika, ad hahu atar deikre tzaddik. vetzaddikim gemurim, nagdin lon mehahu atar deinnun yatve, lehay alma. val da illen illain villen tattain. zakkaa chulakehon demare teshuva. vzakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, divginehon alma mitkayyeyma.

Hada hu dichtiv vhaya ki yechota vashem vegomer. ma ketiv leella, o matza aveda vechichesh bah vegomer, deha begin da istallak kudesha berich hu mikkolla. kivyachol kudesha berich hu la ishtechach bekiyyumeh, deha keneset yisrael itparsha meatraha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 7:28) avda haemuna. (35, 191) may emuna. da keneset yisrael. kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) viemunatcha ballelot. avda haemuna kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 9:11) al ma avda haaretz, vecholla chad. vha okimna avda, vla neevedet, vla avuda. kegavvna da, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatzaddik avad, avud, o neevad, la ketiv, ella avad. hada hu dichtiv avda haemuna, begin kach veheshiv et haggezela o et haaveda vegomer.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemna, duchetin it begehinnam, reshimin limchallele shabbatot befarhesya, vela chazrin betiyyuveta meoto chillul. umemanan alayyhu. veuf hachi duchetin it begehinnam, leinnun dimgale eryayn. uleinnun dimgallin panim battora shelo kahalacha. uleinnun deshafchin dam naki. uleinnun deumin leshakra. uleinnun deshachvin im nidda. o bat el nechar. o zona. o shifcha. veuf hachi, leover al 365 lo taase. lechol chova, it ducheta begehinnam, umemana aleh.

Vesatan yetztzer hara dileh, memana al kullehu chovin, veduchetin umemanan dileh. vei haddar betiyyuveta, ma ketiv, (yeshaya ma) machiti chaav peshaecha, itmachu reshimin derashiayyay deducheta degehinnam mikkol chova vechova.

Veit chovin reshimin leella, vela letatta. veit dirshimin letatta, vela leella. vit dirshimin letatta uleella. itmachun letatta itmechun leella, batar deahadar betiyyuveta. veod ukemuha mare matnitin, rasha avonotav chakukim lo al atztzemotav. tzaddik, zachiotav chakukim lo al atztzemotav. amay. begin lemehevi reshimin ben baale chovehon, leishtemoda behu, vekala nafik aleh, hay rasha ihu yisarfu atztzemotav begehinnam.

Veokimna, nishmot shel reshaim hen hen hammazzikim baolam. vedina dilhon ukemuha alayyhu mare denishmathon matnitin, nisrefet venaaset efer tachat kappot ragle hatztzaddikim. uvemay ittokdun. beesh dechuresya, deittemar beh, (Daniel 7:9) korseyih shevivin di nur galgillohi nur dalik. (venahar dinur nagid venafik) med chevavn deeshsha, desacharin lechuresya dedin, deihu adonay, dina demalchuta dina.

Vhahu nahar, ittemar beh, (Daniel 7:10) nahar di nur nagid venafak min kodamohi. nishmathon detztzaddikayyay, tavlin umitdechin beh. venishmatehon dirshie, nidonin beh, veitbeiru kammeh, kekkash lefanay esh, vehayeynu esh ochelet esh. Adonai ihi chama. nartikah dileh, adonay. lishmor
1066: Vhayeynu raza deukemuha, leatid lavo motztzi hakkadosh baruch hu chama minnartikah tzaddikim mitrappein bah, ureshaim nidonin bah.

Umechevvn dechuresya dedina, hava nachit arye deeshsha lemechal karbenin, innun dimmanan, al kol ever dechav mechabbel kategor echad, kema deokmuha, asa avera achat, kana lo kategor 1. umiyyad denachat esh shel gavoah, veokid lon leillen evarin ufedarin veemurin defarim uchevasim veattudim vizzim. Adonai denachit kearyi deeshsha leokda lon, ittokdun evarim dilhon, ittokdun mechabbelim dimmanan alayyhu, umitkapperin chovin deyisrael, deinnun evarim dishchinta.

Behahu zimna, chevavn mitkarvin dimmanan al zachvavn, deinnun mikkuresyay derachame, deihi teshuva, imma illaa. uvemma mitkarvin. beshem Adonai, deal behon. uvegin da, karban laydod. delet man deyachil lek riv chevavn vysodin, lealaa shelam benayyhu, ella shemeh, dekariv bishmeh mayim leesh, vela mechabbe da leda, vekariv rucha leafra, vela mafrid leh.

Behahu zimna, innun shelamim chevavn visodin, veitkeriu kodashim, delet temeim benayyhu. veod, shelamim da Adonai batraa, deihu shelimu deammuda deemtztzaita, bechol havayot dichlilan beh, lechol shit sitrin dileh, deinnun shit sefiraan.

Vraza demilla, chatam rum ufana lemala, beyhv, limina dechesed. behvy, lismala digvura. 21, beammuda deemtztzaita. 21 benetztzach. behod 21. baysod 21. ilana deachid lon kullehu, tiferet. etz ose peri. uvegin da mekom sheyyippol haetz, sham Yahu. veuf hachi bechol havaya, Adonai batraa shelamim lah. ulechol havavyyayn, daachidan bah. kegavvna da, Yahu im Adonai, Adonai. 21 im Adonai, havaya. 21 im Adonai, vehaya vuf hachi shear havavyyayn.

Vinnun 18 atvavn deshit sitrin, dichlilan betztzaddik chay almin, veim Adonai itavid chayya. veraza demilla ihi Adonai, kegon tevat noach, deitkenish bah mikkol min umin, deinnun shenayim shenayim shiva shiva lekarbena. shenayim shenayim arbaa. shiva shiva arbaa eser. ha 18. vteva Adonai, bah ishtelim chayya.

(Sefer acher patach veamar bati leganni vegomer) vetztzaddik ihu kalil 6 dargin. uvegin da takkinu lemiftar beh chelma beg shelomot, beg pidyonot, deihu 6, bechushevan 6. veihu sullam dechelma deyaakov, kalil 6 sefiran. mutztzav artztza, shechinta tattaa, veda Adonai tattaa. vrosho, da 10, beh ihu tzaddik shevii. maggia hashshamayma, da imma illaa, vda Adonai illaa, demissitra dechelma, Adonai shalta al 10, deihu resha desulema, 15 min elokim. uvegin da, (Bereshit 28:12) vehinne malache elohim olim vegomer, vela malache Adonai.

Atvvn kesidran, olim becholem, deihu keter al 4 atvavn, deitpeshatuta dilhon, mechachma ad malchut kaddisha. begin dechachma ihi 10, bina Adonai, shit sefiran 6, malchut Adonai batraa. cholem keter al kol atvvn. (ad kan raya mehemana) (kan chaser vatematzeahev lekamman daf 246 amud bet davar acher vayachalom vechulei)

(Vayikra 4:3) im hakkohen hammashiach yechota leashmat haam. ribbi abba patach (Shir HaShirim 1:8) haggida li sheahava nafshi vegomer, im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim tzei lach vegomer, hane kerae ukemuha chavrayyay bemoshe, beshaata dehava salik mealma, deamar (Bamidbar 27:17) yifkod Adonai elohe haruchot lechol basar vegomer, asher yitze lifnehem vegomer, vtanenan deal galuta ittemar.

Vta chazi, hane kerae keneset yisrael amaran lemalka kaddisha. haggida li sheahava nafshi, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:3) et sheahava nafshi reitem. ulemalka kaddisha ittemar, ant sheahava nafshi echa tire.

Besifra derav hamenuna sava amar, kol zimna dekneset yisrael ishtechach beh bekudesha berich hu, kivyachol kudesha berich hu bishlimu, vereay biruta leh (valeacheraneyn zan leh) legarmeh, mehahu yeniku dachalava (sefer acher demalka) deima illaa, umehahu yeniku deihu yanik, ashke lechol shear ochoranin, veyanik lon. veolifna deamar rabbi shimon, kol zimna dikkeneset yisrael ishtechachat bekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu bishlimu, bechedva, birchan beh sharyayn, venafkin minneh lechol shear ochoranin. vechol zimna dichneset yisrael la ishtechachat beh bekudesha berich hu, kivyachol birchan itmenau minneh umikkol shear ochoranin.

Vraza demilta, bechol atar dela ishtechach dechar venukeba, birchan la sharan aloy, veal da kudesha berich hu gae uvache, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 25:30) shaog yishag al navihu. umay omer, oy shehcheravti et beti vesarafti et hechali vechulei.
1067: Dekneset yisrael nafkat begaluta, amrat kammeh, haggida li sheahava nafshi, ant rechima denafshay, ant dechol rechimu denafshi bach. echa tire, ech tazun garmach, meamika denachala dela pasik. ech tazun garmach minnehiru deeden illaa. echa tarbitz batztzohorayim, ech tazun lechol innun ochoranin deishshetakyayn minach tadira.

Vaana havina attezna minach bechol yoma, umishshetakya, veashkena lechol innun tattae, veyisrael ittezanu bi, vehasheta shallama ehye keotya, ech ehevi mitattefa, bela birchan, kad yitztarchun innun birchan, vela yishtakkechun bidi. al edre chaverecha, hech ikum alayyhu, vela ehye raya lehu, vezana lehu. edre chaverecha, illen innun yisrael, deinnun bene avahan, deinnun reticha kaddisha leella.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, shevok ant didi, deha didi milla temira hu leityeda. aval im lo tedi lach, legarmach, hare lach eta. hayyafa bannashim, kema deat amer hinnach yafa rayati. tzei lach beikve hatztzon, illen innun tzaddikayyay, deinnun niddashin ben akevin, uveginehon yahiv lach chela lekayyeyma. (veim kol da) urei et gediyyotayich al mishkenot haroim, illen innun tinokot shel bet rabban, dealma mitkayyeyma beginehon, veyahavin chela likkenset yisrael begaluta. mishkenot haroim, illen batte rabban atar bet midrasha deishtechach orayyta behon tadira.

Davar acher im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim vegomer. ta chaze, beshaata detzaddikayyay ishtechachu bealma, veinnun tinokot shel bet rabban mishtakkeche velaan beorayyta, yachla keneset yisrael lekayyeyma immehon begaluta. vei lav, kivyachol hi veinnun la yachle leitkayyeyma bealma. vei zakkain ishtechachu, innun ittafsan bekadmita. vei la, innun gadyayn dealma mitkayyeyma beginehon, mittafsin bekadmita, vekudesha berich hu salik lon mealma, af al gav dela ishtechach behu chova. vela da bilchodoy, ella rachik minneh likkeneset yisrael vitgalyay begaluta.

Hada hu dichtiv im hakkohen hammashiach yechota leashmat haam. amay yechota. leashmat haam, begin chove alma degarmu hay, leashmat haam vday, vela leashma dileh. yechota: yigra tuveh, vedain dineh becholla, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 1:21) vehayiti ani uveni shelomo chattaim. davar acher im hakkohen hammashiach, da kudesha berich hu kidkaamaran. yechota, yigara min keneset yisrael umealma, dela yahiv lehon sippuk birchan. amay. ihu leashmat haam vday, begin chova deamma hi.

(Vayikra 4:3) im hakkohen hammashiach yechota. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Shemot 32:13) zechor leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avadecha, hay kera kashya, hachi mibbae leh lemichtav, zechor leavraham uleyitzchak uleyisrael, may leyitzchak. ella hachi tanenan, bechol atar semala itkelil bimina, uvichlala dimina hu. dehay yemina, ittakkenat lealmin, leachlela beh semala. veal da la palig, begin leachlela leh beh beavraham. uvegin kach leavraham leyitzchak (dayyka) kelala chad. (aval) uleyisrael, deha betarvvyyhu achid lon begadpoy (sefer acher baketapevay), vehu shelim becholla.

Asher nishbata lahem bach. omaa ome kudesha berich hu laavahan, baavahan dilella hada hu dichtiv asher nishbata lahem bach, beinnun dilella beinnun desharan bach. vattedabber alehem arbe et zarachem vegomer. asher amarti, asher amarta mibbae leh. ella kudesha berich hu amar kach laavahan, zimna uteren zimnin. asher amarti: detzaviti biru nafshi, deha amira reuta hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 8:12) adonay amar lishkon baarafel. veod ma tomar nafshecha veeese lach.
Venachalu leolam, may leolam. olam dilella, daachida beh hahi eretz, veittezanat mehahu olam, vei hay eretz itterachat, bemay hu. leashmat haam hu dahavi.
Ribbi yitzchak amar, im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta, da kohen diltatta, deittekan laavoda veishtechach beh chattaa, leashmat haam hu dahavi vadday. vavy leinnun desamichin aleh,
1068: Kegavvna da, shelicha detztzibbura deishtechach beh chattaa, (begin deamma lo ishtechachu zakkain kammeh kudesha berich hu) vavy leinnun desamchin aleh. amar ribbi yehuda, vekol shekken kahana, dechol yisrael, veillain vetattain kullehu achidan (nusach acher mechakkan) umetzappan leitbarcha al yedoy.

Deha tanenan, beshaata dechahana share lechavvevna millin, ulekarva karbena illaa, kolla ishtechachu bevirchata uvechedvavta. yemina, share leitteara. semala itkelil bimina, vecholla itachid veitkeshar da beda, veitbarchun kullehu kachada. ishtechach, deal yeda dechahana, mitbarchan illae vetattae, veha okmuha. uvegin kach bae lekarva karbena aleh, begin deyitkapper choveh.

Amar ribbi yose, ha tanenan, deal yeda dechahana itkappar chova debar nash, kad kariv karbena. hasheta deihu chate, man makriv aleh, uman yechapper aleh. i tema deihu makriv al nafsheh, ha ihu itkalkal, velav ihu keday deyitbarchun aleh illae vetattae. tattae la yitbarchun al yedeh, kol shekken illae. amar ribbi yehuda, vela. veha ketiv (Vayikra 16:6) vechipper baado uvead beto, amay baya lechappera aleh, begin deihu chav yechapper al garmeh, dichtiv vechipper baado.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, ha yedia bean atar itkeshar kahana rabba. uvean atar itkeshar kahana ochora, vehahu deikre segan yedia. begin kach, kohen ochora ka makriv karbaneh bekadmita, vesalik leh ad hahu atar deitkeshar beh. batar dechahana salik lehahu atar, la meakkevin leh lesalleka leatreh, uleitkappera choveh. veal da, ochora ka makriv aleh karbaneh. kevan deochora hu makriv, vela mistappekin kol kach al yedeh, levatar ihu makriv, veinnun illain, kullehu mitchabberan lechappera choveh. umalka kaddisha istekam al yedayyhu. kegavvna da, hamitpalel vtaa yaamod acher tachtav.

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba havo yatve. amar ribbi elazar, chamena leabba beyome derosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, dela bae lemishma tzelota mikkol bar nash, ella i kaim aleh telata yomin kodem, ledakkea leh. deribbi shimon hava amar hachi, bitzlota dehay bar nash daana madkena, itkefar alma. vechol shekken bitkia deshofar, dela mekabbel tekiata debar nash delav ihu chakkim lemitka beraza ditkia.

Detanenan, ribbi yesa sava amar, hane tekiata kesidran. kadmaa, kelila mikkolla. tinyayna, chada kesidra vachada kesidra, gevura gedola benayyhu. telitaa, chad hacha vechad hacha gevura benayyhu. puseka salleka, 30 kumatra nachta. chad takkifa vechad rafya. veha ukemuha. veinnun asara. veinnun tesha. chad kelala decholla.

Uvehay yoma mitattera yitzchak, vehu resha laavahan. behay yoma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 33:14) pachadu vetziyyon chattaim. behay yoma yitzchak itakad, veakid kolla, vesara mallilat (sefer acher maylalet) vekol shofra takkif lachadda. zakkaa chulakeh, man deavar benayyhu, veishteziv minnayyhu. amar ribbi abba, begin kach karenan parsheta deyitzchak behay yoma, divhay yoma itakad yitzchak letatta, vitkeshar behahu dilella. (nusach acher beavraham) ematay itkeshar. beshaata dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:9) vayyaakod et yitzchak beno vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, behay yoma attar yitzchak leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. may nissa. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 49:22) veel ammim arim nissi. (Shemot 17:15) vayikra shemo Adonai nissi. may ka mashma lan. begin deishtachlil yemina veishtelim. hada hu dichtiv vehaelohim nissa et avraham. vhaelohim dayyka, vda hu (Bereshit 31:42) ufachad yitzchak.

Ribbi abba amar, ketiv (Tehillim 75:8-9) ki elohim shofet ze yashpil veze yarim. ki elohim shofet, ilmale deavar dina deyitzchak, baatar deyaakov share, (sefer acher veittase) veitchase (sefer acher veitsache) (sefer acher veitbasam) tamman, vavy lealma deyera begineh, veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 66:16) ki vaesh Adonai nishpat. veda hu itbasmuta dealma.
Vechevan deal beatra deyaakov, veyaakov achid
1069: Beh, keden shachich eshsha, veitztenanu gumereh. lebar nash, dehava ragiz, vechagar vezayin garmeh, venafak berugezeh lekatla livne nasha. chad chakkima kam al pitcha, veachid beh, amar ilmale la achid bi veittekaf bi, ha katula bivne nasha ishtechach. beod deittakafu da beda, veachid da beda, itztenan rugezih al denafak lekatla. nafak leochacha, man savil rugeza vetukepa dedina dehahu bar nash. hevi ema, da dekaim appitcha.

Kacha amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, banay, la tidchalun, ha ana kaim al pitcha, aval izderazu behay yoma vehavu li chela. uvemma. beshshofar. dei ishtechach kol shofar kedka yeot, umechavvevne beh letatta, hahu kala salik, uveh mitattere avahan, vekayyme bemishkeneh deyaakov. veal da bae leizdahara beshofara, uleminda behahu kala ulechavvevna (beh).

Vlet lacha kala beshofara, dela salik rekia chad. vechol innun ochlosin dehahu rekia, yahavin atar lehahu kala, umay ka amre. (Yoel 2:11) vaAdonai natan kolo lifni chelo vegomer. vekaim hahu kala behahu rakia, ad deate kala ochora, vitattedu (sefer acher veattearu) kachada, vesallekin beziuuga lirkia ochora. veal da tanenan, it kol desalik kol, umay ihu. hahu kala ditkiata deyisrael detatta.

Vechevan demitchabberan kol innun kalin diltatta, vesallekin lehahu rekia illaa demalka kaddisha share beh, mitatteran (sefer acher mitattedan) kullehu kame malka, ucheden kuresvavn remiu vechuresyay ochora deyaakov kaim veittakkan.

Al da ashkachna besifra derav hamenuna sava, beinnun tzelote derosh hashshana, dehava amar, tzelota vekol shofara (dehahu kol) deappik hahu zakkaa, deishtechach mirucheh uminafsheh behahu shofara, dehahu kol salik leella. uvehahu yoma kayymin umishtachche mekatregin leella. vechad salik hahu kala deshofara, kullehu itdachyayn kameh, vela yachlin lekayyeyma. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyadin lechavvevna reuta lekame marehon, veyadin letakkena alma behay yoma, bekal shofara. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua. yode, vela toke.

Behay yoma, bae amma leistakkela bebar nash shelim mikkolla, deyada archoy demalka kaddisha, deyada bikara demalka, deyive alayyhu bauta behay yoma. ulezimna kal shofara bechullehu almin, bechavavna delibba, bechachmeta, biruta, bishlimu. begin deyistalak dina al yedoy min alma. vavy leinnun dishlicha dilhon la ishtechach kedka yeot, deha chove alma (amma) atyayn leadkera begineh. hada hu dichtiv, im hakkohen hammashiach yechota, dehu shelicha dechol yisrael, leashmat haam hu, begin dedina sharya alayyhu.

Vchad shelicha hu zakkaa kedka yeot, zakkain innun amma, dechol dinin mistallekin minnayyhu al yedeh, kol shekken kahana, dealeh mitbarchan illae vetattae. amar ribbi elazar, veal da, kohen velevi ad la yisllak lefulechana, badkin avatreh, veyadin archoy veovadoy, vei la, la salik lefulechana, vechen besanhedrin lemedan dina.

Vei ishtechach kadka yeot, yahavin aleh chumera demakdesha. vei la, la salik lefulechana. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:8) ulelevi amar tummecha veurecha leish chasidecha. mippeni ma zacha (aharon) leurim uletumim, ulemiflach pulechana. heve omer (Devarim 33:9) asher nissito vegomer. haomer leaviv uleimmo lo reitiv vegomer. vechevan deishtechachu beillen dargin, keden yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vegomer, yasimu ketora vegomer. leshakkecha rugeza, ulezamna shelama. vechalil al mizbechecha, begin deyitbassemun kolla, veyishtakkechun birchan bechullehu almin, keden (Devarim 33:10) barech Adonai chelo vegomer.

(Vayikra 4:13) veim kol adat yisrael yishgu venellam vegomer. rabbi shimon patach, (Yeshayahu 32:9) nashim shaanannot komna shemana koli vegomer. kamma it leh lebar nash, leistakkela bikara demareh, begin deyishtechach birya shelim kammeh kudesha berich hu, dechad bara kudesha berich hu lebar nash
1070: Bara leh shelim, kema deittemar, (Kohelet 7:29) asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vegomer. et haadam dechar venukeba. venukeba itkelilat bidchura, ucheden yashar ketiv. levatar vehema vikshu cheshbonot rabbim.

Ta chazi, minukeba dithoma rabba illaa, ishtechachat chad nukeba ruchata dechol ruchin, veha okimna lilit shemah. vehi ishtechachat bekadmita legabbe adam. uveshaata deitbere adam, veishtelim gufeh, izdemanu al hahu gufa elef ruchin missitra dismala. da beda leaala beh, veda baa leaala beh, vela havo yachle, ad degaar behu kudesha berich hu, veadam hava shachiv gufa bela rucha, vechezu dileh yeroka hava, vechol innun ruchin sacharan aleh.

Behahi shaata nachit anana chad, vdacha (vezarik) lechol innun ruchin. uveshaata da ketiv, (Bereshit 1:24) vayomer elohim totze haaretz nefesh chayya veha okimna, denukeba itabberat min dechura min hahu nefesh deadam, vehi appikat hahu rucha, lenashva beh baadam, kalil mitteren sitrin kadka chazi, hada hu dichtiv, (bareasheyteb) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya. lenefesh chayya mammash. uman deistappak behay, begin dela yada, i chayya zo hi chayya tattaa, o chayya dishmah yisrael, o middechura o minukeba. aval la ketiv lenefesh hachayya, ella lenfesh chayya setam, demashma kolla.

Vchad kam adam, havavt nukevateh tekua besitroy. vehahi nishmeta kaddisha deveh, hava asge lehay sitra, ulehay sitra, vesage lehay ulehay, begin dehachi itkelilat. levatar nasar kudesha berich hu leadam, vetakin lenukeveh, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 2:22) vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela vegomer. et hatztzela ha okimna, kema deat amer (Shemot 26:20) uletzela hammishkan. vayvieha el haadam, betikkunaha kechalla lachuppa.

Kevn dechamat lilit da, arkat, vehi bichrache yamma, vead kean hi zemina leavasha bene alma. vechad zammin kudesha berich hu lecharba romi reshiata, ulemeheve chorban lealmin, yesallek lehay lilit, veyishre lah lehay chureba, begin dehi chorbena dealma. hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya la) ach sham hirgia lilit umatza lah manoach.

Uvesifre kadmae amre, deihi arkat min adam mikkadmat dena, vaanan la tanenan hache, begin deha nukeba da ishtekachat immeh, aval ad la kamat hay nefesh (sefer acher deha nukeba da lo ishtechachat immeh aval ad lo ittaknat nukeba da) immeh deadam kedka yeot, havat mizdavvga immeh vechad hay ittakkenat immeh kedka yeot, arkat hi leyama, uzemina leavasha beni alma.

Asvavta lehay, behahi shaata deizdavvavg bar nash beitteteh, yechavvivn libbeh bikdushsha demare, velema hache, atifa bekitfa izdammenat, share share, la tiol vela tinpok, la didach vela beadvach. tuv tuv, yamma itregisha, galgalloy lich karan, bechulaka kaddisha achidna, bikdushsha demalka itattafna.

Ulechafya leh leresheh uleitteteh ad shaata chada, vechen bechol zimna, ad 3 yomin lakkelita, dechol harekava dela koletet leg yomin, tuv leta koletet. uvesifra deanach ashmeday lishlomo malka amar, telatin yomin. veamar dilvatar desiyyem ovada, lishde mayin tzelilan socharaneh learseh. unetura decholla. (levatar)

Man deyanka leravyya, la tizdavvivg levar nash, ella beshaata deravya naim. ulevatar la tanik leh, ad shaata chada, kitren millin, o chad mil, i la yachla begin tzaara deravya, bezimna deihu bache. uveda la mistafe minnah lealmin.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu olif lon razin amikin dilella vetatta, vecholla begin orayyta, deha orayyta, man deyishtaddal bah, mitattar beitrin dishma kaddisha, deha orayyta shema kaddisha hu. uman deyishtaddal bah, itreshim veitattar bishma kaddisha, ucheden yada archin setimin, verazin amikin dilella vetatta, vela mistafe lealmin.
1071: Behahu yoma itpekadu al ilana chad, veavru al pikkuda demarehon, uvegin deitteta hi chavat bekadmita, veata ala hahu nachash, ketiv, (Bereshit 3:16) vehu yimshol bach. mikkan ulehala, bechol zimnin deguverin ishtechachu chayyayvin kame kudesha berich hu, ha okimna deinnun nashim (dilella) missitra dedina kashya, zeminin leshalletaa alehon, missitra dedina kashya, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:12) ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo, nashim mashlu vo vday.

Veillen ikrun lahat hacherev hammithappechet, lav deinnun cherev hammithappechet, ella lahat mehahu cherev, deikre (Vayikra 26:25) cherv nokemet nekam berit, (yeshaya la) cherev laAdonai mala dam. vehahu lahat hacherev mithappechet, lezimnin guverin ulezimnin nukevin, veha okimna.

Vavy lealma, kad innun nashin shaltan bealma, kad chama nevia, deyisrael meakme archayyhu, veinnun ishtechachu bechovin kame marehon, keden amar, nashim shaanannot hech attun shekitan, hech attun yatvan dela leitteara bealma, komna. uveatar ochora (160) okimna lehay kera (kan chaser veayyen lekamman 167 amud bet). veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

Aval la ittemar, ella kema deashkechan bidvora. dichtiv (Shoftim 4:4) hi shofta et yisrael baet hahi. veal da tanenan, vavy lebar nash deitteta ka mevarcha leh lefatora. kach devora, hi shofta et yisrael baet hahi, vavy ledara dela ishtechach behu man dedain leamma, ella chad nukeba.

Ta chaze, teren nashin innun deishtekachu bealma, veamre tushebachta dekudesha berich hu, dechol guverin dealma la yemrun hache. uman innun. devora. vechanna. channa amra, (Shmuel 1 2:2) en kadosh kaAdonai ki en biltecha vechullehu kerae. dehi patchat pitcha dimhemnuta lealma, kegon (Shmuel 1 2:8) mekim meafar dal meashpot yarim evyon, ha pitcha dimhemnuta. lehoshivi im nedivim, ha mehemnuta dilella, baatar daavahan sharyayn. man nedivim. illen avahan, kedichtiv (Tehillim 47:10) nedive ammim neesafu.

Davar acher lehoshivi im nedivim, nibbea al shemuel, deihu zammin leitkesha im moshe veaharon, dichtiv, (Tehillim 99:6) moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo. (Shmuel 1 2:8) vechisse chavod yanchilem. man yanchilem. da shemuel. deachasin yekara demalchuta litren malchin. davar acher vechisse chavod yanchilem, da kudesha berich hu dehu achasin kuresyay dileh leavdohi, hada hu dichtiv vechisse chavod yanchilem.

(Od) (Shmuel 1 2:10) Adonai yechattu merivav, merivav chaser, may ka mayyre. ella merivav tanenan, meriv 6, veda malka kaddisha veraza dechachmeta ittemar hacha, beshaata dedinin mittearin veshallitin shaltin al rachame, verachame itkafyayn, uveshaata dekudesha berich hu itberach mimmabbua denachala, keden gavrin rachame veitkafyayn dine, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yechattu merivav meriv 6.

Alav bashshamayim yarem. alav. may alav. beshaata detala deattika kaddisha sharya aleh, umalya resheh, behahu atar deikre shamayim, keden yarem: yattebar chelehon vetukefehon dedinin takkifin. veyitten oz lemalko, da kudesha berich hu. veyarem keren meshicho, da keneset yisrael deikre keren hayyovel (sefer acher 33 hayyovel) kema deokimna. meshicho kema deat amer (Melachim 2 23) meshiach elohe yaakov, begin kach keren meshicho, vha ittemar.

Devora deatat leshabbecha shevacha demalka kaddisha, (Shoftim Adonai:4) Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom. melammed, dekudesha berich hu azmin lechol shear ammin lekabbela leorayyta, vela bau. vechi la hava galle kameh dela baan, ella dela yehe lon pitchon pe, deilmale yahav lon kudesha berich hu orayyta havo natre lah. vechol innun kerae deamra devora, kullehu beraza dechachmeta, ad hahi shaata deshabbechat garmah, shenneemar ad shakkamti devora shakkamti em beyisrael, deha ukemuha deistallak minnah ruach nevua, uvegin kach (Shoftim Adonai:12) uri uri devora uri uri dabberi shir.
Vchol da, kad ishtechachu guverin bechattaa, velav innun kedain lemishre alayyhu ruach kudesha vday.
1072: (Vayikra 4:13) vim kol adat yisrael yishgu vegomer, kema deokimna behoraa detau bah. aval vim kol adat yisrael yishgu, vim kol yisrael yishgu mibbae leh, may kol adat yisrael. ella innun (kulehon) deishtakkechan biyrushala 40, deha mittamman nafka orayyta lechol amma, vei innun dahavo tamman taan, kol yisrael taan, vtanenan dechevan detamman taan, kol amma taan, begin dechullehu mashche avatrayyhu. vnellam davar meene hakkahal, ene hakkahal illen sanhedre, illen innun dimmanan al yisrael.

Raya mehemna pikkuda da lehavi karban al sanheddere gedola shetau, tanain vamorain 70 sanheddere gedola hayu, umoshe alayyhu. ve sanheddere ketanna havo, vaharon alayyhu. uvegin da amru mare matnitin, moshe shushevina demalka hava, veda tiferet, mittamman sanheddere gedola. aharon shushevina dematronita, veda malchut, hei zeera karenan leh, kegon (Bereshit 29:18) eevadcha sheva shanim berachel bittecha hakketanna. veal shemah itkere sanheddere ketanna.

Umittamman havo ydin sanhedrin shivin lashon, deinnun shivim panim lattora, deit shivim lashon missitra demalchut harshaa vechulei, kolla beferuda. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 10:Adonai) meelle nifredu iyye haggoyim beartztzotam lilshonotam kullehu shivin lashon beferuda da min da.

Aval beorayyta, 70 panim lattora belashon chad. veda yesod. 6 halacha chada, chachma zeera malchut, devah shivin lashon, kechusheban sod, min yesod. visod ihu lashon hakkodesh, sod hamerkava, beshivin kattedrain, alayyhu ittemar kol haone amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach bechol kocho, korin lo gezar dino shel shivim shana. lashon chad, ihu shivim lashon, al midda zeera dechachma zeera, deihi 10 al midda zeera. al chachma zeera deihi 10, al midda zeera dechachma 2, teren sifvvn, dibbehon daat utevuna, behon ishtelimu shivin uteren. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle beorcha, ad dahavo azle. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, nishtaddel bemille deorayyta, bemille deattik yomin. patach ribbi chiyyay veamar, (Tehillim 32:5) chattati odiacha vegomer, mikkan olifna, dechol bar nash dimchasse chetoy vla meforash lon kame malka kaddisha, veyitba alayyhu rachame, la yahavin leh lemiftach pitcha ditshuva, begin deihu ichsif (nusach acher mechase) minneh. vei ihu parish lon kame kudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu chayis aleh veyitgabberun rachame al dina.

Vkol shekken i ihu bache, deha kol pitchin setimin ihu patach, veitkabbal tzeloteh, veal da, perishu dechetoy, yekara hu demalka, leagbara rachame al dina. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 50:23) zoveach toda yechabbedanni. mahu yechabbedanni. teren kivudin innun, chad leella, vechad letatta, chad bealma den, vechad bealma deate.

Hay kera kashya becholla, bisgiut millin, deha beode ale peshaay sagi. mahu chatati odiacha vaavoni lo chissiti, ulevatar ode ale feshaay laAdonai, veod deha ode ale peshaay laAdonai, lecha mibbae leh.

Ella david, kol milloy beruach hakkodesh amaran, ulemalchuta dishmayya amar, begin deihi shelicha mittattae leillae, umeillae letattae, uman devae lemalka, lah oda bekadmita. veal da chattati odiacha, (davar acher lemalkevata dishmayya kaamar) vaavoni lo chissiti, mitztzaddiko shel olam. amarti ode ale feshaay laAdonai, da malka kadisha, dishlama kolla dileh, ushelama devae bar nash leaalaa kameh behodaa. deha shelamim hachi mitkarvin behodaa, dichtiv (Vayikra 7:13) al zevach todat shelamav. (Tehillim 32:5) veatta nasata avon chattati sela. da leella leella, atar deattika kaddisha sharya. begin kach, hay kera achid becholla.

Kegavvna da, man deyitba bauteh lemalka, bae leyachada shema kadisha biruteh, mittatta leella umeella letatta, ulekashshera kolla bechad kishra, uvehahu kishshura ishtechach bauteh. amar ribbi yose, man hu chakkima, lemitba bauteh kedavid malka, dehu hava natir pitcha demalka. amar leh ribbi chiyyay vday hachi hu. veal da orayyta olif lan, arche
1073: Demalka kaddisha, begin deninda lemehach avatreh, kema deat amer (Devarim 13:5) achare Adonai elohechem telechu vegomer.

Ribbi yose patach vamar, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma nehi bechi vegomer. ko amar Adonai, ha ukemuha, bechol atar dinvia share lemallela, havo milloy ishtemodan, vehacha hay ko amar Adonai, kudesha berich hu. uma amar, kol berama nishma.

Hachi tanenan, divhahu yoma deitcharav be makdesha letatta, veyisrael azlu begaluta, rechayin al tzavarehon, videhon mehaddekan laachora. ucheneset yisrael, itterachat mibbet malka lemehach batrehon. beshaata denachtat, amrat ehach bekadmita veevke al madoray, veal banay, veal baali. kad nachtat, chamat atraha chariv, vechamma dama dechaside ittoshad begavvav, vhechala kaddisha uveta ittokad beeshsha.

Keden arimat kala, veitregishu illae vetattae, umata kala leella, ad atar demalka share beh. uvaa malka leahadra alma letohu vavohu, ad denachtu kama ochlosin, vechamma mashshiryayn, lokovlah vela kibbela tanchumin minnayyhu. hada hu dichtiv kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha meana lehinnachem al baneha, dela kibbela minnayyhu tanchumim. ki enennu: begin demalka kaddisha hava salik leella leella, vela ishtechach begavvav, hada hu dichtiv ki ennnu, vla ketiv ki enam.

Amar leh ribbi chiyyay, may rachel mevakka al baneha. amar leh olifna, dehi keneset yisrael. veda intu deyaakov vday, dichtiv (Bereshit 29:18) vayyeehav yaakov et rachel. uchetiv, (Bereshit 29:18) vrachel akara. uchetiv, hatam (Tehillim 113:9) moshivi akeret habbayit em habbanim semecha.

Davar acher ki enennu, kema deittemar, (Bereshit 39:9) enennu gadol babbayit vegomer, enennu: deha istalik leella veitrechik micholla. enennu: beziuuga ba. enennu: leishtakkecha (Shemot 165) shemeh rabba.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, mean atar sharya leitgallaa. amar leh, mibbe makdesha. detamman sharya ulevatar ascharat kol ara deyisrael. levatar kad nafkat min ara, kamat al madbera veyativat tamman telat yomin. dabberat uchelusaha umashshiryayha (sefer acher vametaybatehaa) veyatvaha mibbe malka, vekarata alah (Eicha 1:1) echa yashva vadad vegomer. bachu ribbi chiyyay vribbi yose.

Amar ribbi yose, la galu yisrael meara, vela itcharav be makdesha, ad deyisrael kullehu ishtekachu bechiuva kame malka, vead dedabbere alma ishtekachu bechiuva bekadmita. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:12) ammi meashsherecha matim vederech orchotecha billeu. dechevan dereshe amma azlin bechiuva, kol amma itmeshachu avatrayyhu. ribbi chiyyay amar mehacha, veim kol adat yisrael yishgu, bemay havi. begin venellam davar meeni hakkahal. deenay amma innun reshayyhu, dechol amma itmashshechan avatrayyhu.

Azlu. ad dahavo azle chamu chad atar medushshana baasavin, unehar mayya dehava nagid beh. yatvu. ad dahavo yatve, parach chad ofa verachish kamayyhu. amar ribbi chiyyay, nikum mehacha, devadday nagre turayya hacha mishtakkechin, kamu veazlu. ad deahadru reshayyhu, chamu innun listin derahatin avatrayyhu, itrechish lon nisa, veashkachu kamayyhu chad tinara, vechad mearta beh, alu tamman yatvu kol hahu yoma vechol lelya.

Patach ribbi chiyyay vamar, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veatta al tira avdi yaakov vegomer, ki hinni moshiacha merachok. merachok, mikkarov mibbae leh. veha ukemuha hay kera, merachok, kema deat amer veshavu meeretz merchak. aval merachok, kehahu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:16) merachok Adonai nira li. uchetiv (Mishlei 31:14) mimmerchak tavi lachmah. uman hi. (Bereshit 221 amud alef) amika denachala, atar dehahu nahar nagid venafik. veshav yaakov, kevan dichtiv al tira avdi yaakov, mahu veshav yaakov. ella kema detanenan, kudesha berich hu salik leella leella, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 10:1) lama Adonai taamod berachok, umehahu atar rachok hinni moshiacha.

Vshav yaakov, leatreh (lakevaresaya), leizdavvevga bichneset yisrael. veshakat: da yesod. veshaanan, lemishre diureh ba. veen macharid, miyyitzchak. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 27:33) vayyechorad yitzchak charada gedola
1074: Veal da (Bereshit 31:42) ufachad yitzchak ketiv. vehahu pachad kad ittear, istallak yesod laatar ochora, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:14) pachadu vetziyyon chattaim. betziyyon dayyka, veal da veen macharid, vehasheta kudesha berich hu sheziv lan merachik, veastir lan behay atar, behasheket uveshalva, veen macharid mikkolla. dechad kudesha berich hu avid nisa becholla avid.

Ribbi yose patach, (Shoftim 4:8) vayyomer eleha barak im telchi immi vehalachti vegomer, may ka mayyre. ella amar barak hoil veruach kaddisha sharya alah, bizchutah ishteziv, vela lishre alay nizka. uma barak samich al itteta leishtezava beginah. anan deorayyta immana dehi shemeh demalka kaddisha, al achat kamma vechamma.

Yatvu go hahu mearta kol hahu yoma, kad ramash lelya, itnehir sihara bimarta. avru tere tayyaye, vachamarehon teinin mechamra umechla legarmayyhu share al matula. amre hay lehay, navit hacha, nihav mechla umishteyay lachamare, vaanan naul limarta da. amar leh chavreh ad la niul, tema hay kera dela mityayshsheva.

Amar leh may hu. amar leh milla chad, dichtiv, (Tehillim 52:11) odcha leolam ki asita vegomer. mahu ki asita, vela ketiv ma. uchetiv chi tov neged chasidecha. vechi legabbe ochora lav ihu tov, la hava bideh. amar vavy letiuana, deshavakna lekudesha berich hu begineh. ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose dahavo yatve bimarta chadu, amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, vela amarit lecha dechad avid kudesha berich hu nisa, becholla avid. nafku.

Kad nafku akdim ribbi chiyyay ufatach, (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok. tere shelama hacha, chad larachok, vechad lakkarov, vecholla chad. larachok, deitavid karov. (406 larachok) da hu mareh ditshuva, kodem hava rachok, vehasheta ihu karov. tu rachok, kad bar nash itrechik meorayyta. rachik hu mekudesha berich hu. uman dekariv leorayyta, kariv leh kudesha berich hu bahadeh, vehasheta itchabbaru immana veulu limarta atu innun tayayin veishtattafu immehon. ishtenkalu lachamarayyhu, vatkinu lemechal, nafku kullehu lefum mearta.

Amar chad min tayyan nemru lan mare deorayyta, hay kera odcha leolam ki asita vaak1ve vegomer. ki asita, mahu ki asita, vela ketiv ma. uchetiv ki tov neged chasidecha, vechi legabbe ochora lav hu tov.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, ki asita vday, uma asita. leolam. divgin hay olam, daavad kudesha berich hu veattekan leh, ode bar nash lekudesha berich hu bechol yoma. vaak1ve shimcha chi tov neged chasidecha, hachi hu vday, lokovel innun zakkain, shema dekudesha berich hu tov. vela lokovle chayyayvayya, dimvazzin leh bechol yoma vela mishtaddele beorayyta. amar leh, yeot hu. aval milla shemana mibbatar kotala, umistafena legallaa. amru leh ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, ema millach, deorayyta lav ihu yeruta laatar chad.

Amar lon, yoma chad havina azil lelud, alana lemata, veismachna garmay batar kotala chad, verabbi shimon ben yochay hava behahu beta, veshamana mippumeh hay kera, odcha leolam ki asita. odcha, david hammelech alav hashalom (lekudesha berich hu) amaro, al hahu olam batraa, deihu avad dedavid malka achid beh behahu olam, uveh yarit malchuta. vaakkave shimcha ki tov, da kudesha berich hu, beyichuda dehay alma deikre tov. ematay ikre tov. neged chasidecha. man innun chasidecha.

Ella it chesed veit chesed, villen ikrun chasde davd (vaychi 219, teruma 169) hanneemanim. vechad illen chasde david itmalleyayn mehahu tivu dingidu deattika kaddisha, keden ikre yesod tov. keden ishtechach tov legabbayyhu. deha (sefer acher kad ishtechach kema deihu beh) kema deishtechach deihu beh, hachi ihu mevassam lehay alma batraa. vecholla ishtechach bivracha, veal da david hava mechakke lehay darga, denahir lehay olam deihu achid beh.
Millin illen hachi shemana lon, aval la yedana may hu. atu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose venashsheku leh beresheh. amar ribbi
1075: Chiyyay, man chappe enaych beafra rabbi shimon ben yochay, deant beatrach veant marish turayya illae, vaafillu tzippore shemaya vecholla chaddan bemilulach vavy lealma behahi shaata kad tistallak minneh.

Tu patach veamar hahu gavra, ha milla ochora shemana minneh behahi shaata, bakkera dichtiv, (Daniel 9:17) veatta shema elohenu el tefillat avdecha veel tachnunav vegomer lemaan adonay. vamar hache, i shema da mealleya (nusach acher leella) mikkolla, shappir hu, dehachi amrin avid bedil malka. aval shema da, ha yedia dehu atar be dina, deminneh nafik dina lealma. man chama deamrin lemalka, avid begin avdecha, o begin milla zeera minach.

Ella hachi itzterich, dishma da atkin beta lemalka, uve makdesha letatta, veda achid beda, begin deitkashar da beda. vechad makdesha letatta kaim bekiyyumeh, hay shema leella kaim bekiyyumeh. veda hu keman deamar lemalka bene beta da, vehechala da, begin dela yishtechachat matronita deyatva levar mehechalah. uf hacha, (Daniel 9:17) vehaer panecha al mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay. may tama lemaan adonay. dela yishtekach levar min diureh.

Tavvhu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, vechaddu behahu lelya. batar deachlu, patach chavreh tayyeya veamar, ema kammayychu milla chad, deishtedalna beh hay yoma, hay kera dichtiv, (Tehillim 63:1) mizmor ledavid bihyoto bemidbar yehuda, david amar shirata, kad hava arik mechamoy, amay amar (Tehillim 63:2) elohim eli atta ashacharekka tzama lecha nafshi vegomer. elohim eli atta, deha bigvura achida tedira. ashacharekka, vechi david hech yachil leshachara leh lekudesha berich hu, beara rechika, veittarach meara dishchinta sharya.

Ella, af al gav deittarach mittamman, la shavik dideh leshachara leh lekudesha berich hu. vaana shemana, ashacharekka: keman deamar, ezil leitchazaa kammach, bar dela yachilna. kach ashacharekka, bar daana levar meatar dishchinta sharya. tzama lecha nafshi, deha nafshay vegufa dili teivin legabbach, leitchazaa kammach, vela yachilna, begin daana bearetz tziyya veayifi beli mayim, deha eretz tziyya veayef ikre levar meatar dishchinta sharya. begin demayim chayyim la shechiach hacha. uman innun mayim chayyim. da shechinta, dichtiv bah (Bereshit 26:19) beer mayim chayyim, veal da eretz tziyya vayef beli mayim ketiv.

Amru ribbi chiyyay veribbi yosi, vadday orcha takina kaman, alu limarta vedamchu. befalgu lelya, shamu kal chevata bemadbera denahame. attearu. amar ribbi chiyyay, ha iddan hu lesayyeya lichneset yisrael, dehi meshabbachat lemalka. amru, kol chad vechad lema milla mimma deshama veyada beorayyta, yatvu kullehu.

Patach ribbi chiyyay vamar, (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid. man ayyelet hashshachar. da keneset yisrael. deikre (Mishlei Adonai:19) ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen. vechi ayyelet hashshachar, vela kol yoma. ella, ayyelet: mehahu atar, deikre ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen. vehi atya mehahu atar deikre shachar, kema deat amer (Hoshea 6:3) kashachar nachon motzao, vedavid malka al keneset yisrael kaamar da, deha lo amra keneset yisrael da (sefer acher deikre ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen vehi atyay mehahu atar deikre shachor kema deat amar kashshachar nachon motzao vedavid malka al keneset yisrael kaamar da) mashma dichtiv al ayyelet hashshachar.

Ta chazi, beshaata deramash lelya, pitchin setimin deillae vetattae mishtakkeche (sefer acher mishtachche). vechol innun rechikin, mitarin veazlin veshatan kol alma, umehadderin al gufe beni nasha, vesachare leatrayyhu ulearsayyhu. vechaman diyyukena demalka kaddisha, umistafe. deha ittakafu bearsayyhu bemile dishma kaddisha. uvene nasha, nishmathon sallekin kol chad vechad kidchaze leh, veha ukemuha. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, denishmathon sallekin leella, vela mitakkeve baatar ochora dela itzterich.
Kad itpelag lelya, karoza kaim vechariz, ufitchin petichu. keden rucha chad distar tzafon ittear, veakish
1076: Bechinor dedavid, umenaggen meelav. veshabbechat lemalka, vekudesha berich hu mishtaashea betzaddikayyay beginta deeden.

Zakkaa chulakeh man deittear behahu zimna veishtaddal beorayyta, vechol man dekaim behahu zimna veishtaddal beorayyta, ikre chavreh dekudesha berich hu uchenset yisrael. velo od, ella deillen ikrun achim vereim leh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach. veikrun chaverim bahade malachin illain, umashiryayn illain, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) chaverim makshivim lekolech.

Kad ate yemama, karoza kaim vechariz, ufatchin distar daroma itpetachu. umitarin kochavim umazzalot, ufitchin derachamin itpetachu. umalka yetiv vekabbil tushebchan. keden keneset yisrael natla leinnun millin vesalleka. vechol innun chaverim achidan begadpaha, umillayyhu atyayn vesharyayn becheka demalka. keden pakid malka, lemichtav kol innun millin.

Uvesifra ketivu kol innun bene hechaleh, vechuta dechesed itmeshach alayyhu, demehahu chuta itattar bar nash beitra demalka, uminneh dachalin illain vetattain, hu al bechol tare malka, velet man deyimche bidoy. vaafillu bezimna demarehon dedina kayymin lemedan alma, la dayynin aleh dina. begin deha itreshim birshimu demalka, deishtemoda deihu mehechala demalka, uvegin da la dayynin aleh dina. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, vechol shekken bezimna demalka taiv al mille deorayyta.

Ta chaze, raza demilla, la kayyeyma keneset yisrael kame malka ella beorayyta. vechol zimna deyisrael beara ishtedalu beorayyta. keneset yisrael sharat immehon. kad itbetalu mimmille orayyta, la yachla lekayyeyma immehon shaata chada. begine kach, beshaata dichneset yisrael attearat legabbe malka beorayyta, ittakif chelaha, umalka kaddisha chadde lekabbela lah.

Vchol zimna dichneset yisrael atat lekame malka, veorayyta la ishtechachat immah, kivyachol tashash chelaha. vavy leinnun dimchalleshin chela dilella, begine kach, zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta, vekol shekken behahi shaata deitzterich leishtattefa bah bichneset yisrael. keden kudesha berich hu kari aleh, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 21:11) massa duma elay kore misseir shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. hay kera okmuha chavrayyay, bechamma atar. aval massa duma, kol zimnin deyisrael ishtechachu begaluta, ityeyda zimna vekitza dilhon, vezimna vekitza dehahu galuta. vegaluta deedom, hu massa duma, dela itgalyay vela ityeyda keinnun ochoranin.

Kudesha berich hu amar, elay kore misseir, kala shemana begaluta deshair, innun dedachake benayyhu, innun deshachve leafra. umay amre. shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel innun tavan li al matronita, ma avadit min matronita dili.

Keden kudesha berich hu kanish lefamalya dileh, veamar, chamu banay rechimay, deinnun dechikin begaluta, veshavkin tzaara dilhon, vetavin li al matronita. veamre, shomer: ant deikre shomer, an hu shemira dilach an hu shemira devetach. ma millayla: ma avdat millayla, hachi natrat lah. ma millel. deha lezimnin itkere layla, ulezimnin itkere lel, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:42) lel shimmurim hu. uchetiv hu hallayla hazze.

Keden kudesha berich hu ativ lon, ha shemira didi ishtechach, deha ana zammin lokovlah, uleishtakkecha bahadah, hada hu dichtiv amar shomer, hahu denatir beta, ata voker vegam layla. deha bekadmita istallak leella leella, vesalik lehahu (sefer acher atar) boker (74 amud bet) deizdeman beh tedira. hasheta ata boker. ha zammin leitchabbera ballayla. vegam layla, ha zemina hi. aval beginechon itakkevu. vei attun baan da, al ma attun mitakkeve, shuvu. shuvu bitshuva. keden etayu, atu legabbay, veneheve kolla bemadora chada, vechullana netuv leatrana. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha, vheshiv la neemar,
1077: Ella veshav. teren veshav veshav ketiv hacha. ella, chad lichneset yisrael. vechad lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha veshav vekibbetzcha mikkol haammim.

Patach hahu tayyeya veamar, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol beni elohim. ta chaze, kad kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden, kol mille dealma tattaa (sefer acher illaa), vechol illain vetattain mitarin lokovleh. vechol ilane divginta deeden, patche shevacha lokovleh. hada hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 16:33) az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai ki va. vafillu ofe deara, kullehu merachashe shevacha kammeh. keden shalhova nafak, uvatash begadpoy detarnegola, vekare veshabbach lemalka kaddisha. vekare livne nasha deyishtadlun beorayyta, uvishvacha demarehon, uvepulechaneh. zakkaa chulakehon deman dekayymin mearsayyhu, leishtaddela beorayyta.

Kad ate tzafra, pitchin didroma niftachin, vetare deasvvavta nafkin lealma, verucha demizrach ittear, verachame ishtekachu, vechol innun kochvayya umazzale dimmanan techot shuletaneh dehay boker, kullehu patchin shevacha vezamrin lemalka illaa. hada hu dichtiv, beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim, ma baan hacha bene elohim, deinnun mezammenin terua behay boker, veha kol dinin itavaru bezimna dechesed atar bealma. ella vayyariu kol bene elohim, ha ittebar tukepa dedinin kashyayn, attebar chela dilhon, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 24:19) roa hitroa aretz.

Vechol kach, begin dehay boker ittear bealma, veavraham ittear veate leminta eshel biver shava. milla da hachi shemana lah, biver shava vadday, uchetiv (Bereshit 21:33) vayyikra sham beshem Adonai el olam.

Patach chavrih tayaya veamar, (Bereshit 45) habboker or vehaanashim shullechu vegomer, may habboker or. hachi olifna, mahu boker. ella bezimna deate tzafra, vedinin mitabberan, vechesed baa leitteara, kol innun deatyayn missitra da, mevakkere (sefer acher mapekadey) leatrayyhu, lezammena birchan lealma. veda hu habboker or, deha rachame mityashve lealma, vechesed kae beatreh, keden hu boker or. uchetiv (Bereshit 1:4) vayar elohim et haor ki tov.

Ta chaze, kolla hu bedargin yedian. lelya, ha yedia. boker or, ha yedia, vehu darga illaa deishtechach beh tadira. ematay. kad nahir shimsha. shimsha yedia, vehu darga illaa, dimvassam lecholla, venahir lecholla, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 84:12) ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim. vehay boker or, nahir mishimmesha, veda nahir lelelya. begin kach, kolla talya da beda. vehay boker or kad ittear, kol bene alma itachadan beachaduta bechedvata, umishtakkeche bealma, vehasheta ha nahir yemama, iddan reuta hu, lemehach beorcha.

Berichu lon ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, venashsheku lon bereshayyhu, veshaddaru lon. amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, berich rachamana, detakkin archana kamman, vday kudesha berich hu shadar lon gabban. zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta, vela arpin minnah shaata chada. nafku ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, veazlu learchayyhu. amar ribbi yose, vadday rechimuta delibbay kashir beillen tayyaye. amar ribbi chiyyay, la tavvavhna al da, deha beyomoy deribbi shimon, afillu tzippore shemaya merachshan chachmeta, deha milloy ishtemodan leella vetatta.

Patach ribbi chiyyay vamar, (Devarim 31:15-16) vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinnecha shochev im avotecha vegomer. ta chazi, kol zimna dehava moshe kayyaym bealma, hava mamche bidayyhu deyisrael, begin dela yishtakkechun bechiuva kame kudesha berich hu uvegin demoshe ishtechach benayyhu la yehe kehahu dara ad dara deyete malka meshicha deyechomu yekara dekudesha berich hu kevvtayyhu deinnun itdabbeku ma dela itdebaku darin ochoranin.

Detanenan, chamat shifcha chada al yamma, ma dela chamat ena diychezkel nevia. i innun itdabbaku kol kach, neshehon deyisrael kol shekken. benayyhu kol shekken. guverin kol shekken. sanhedrin kol shekken. nesiim kol shekken, vekol shekken nevia illaa mehemana moshe, deihu al kolla. vehasheta illen tayyaye madbera merachashin chachmeta kol kach, kol shekken chakkime dara, kol shekken innun dekayyme kammeh derabbi shimon, veolfe mineh bechol
1078: Yoma. kol shekken vekol shekken rabbi shimon dehu illaa al kolla.

Batar demit moshe, ma ketiv, (Devarim 31:16) vekam haam hazze vezana vegomer. kach, vavy lealma kad yistalak minneh rabbi shimon, demabbue dechachmeta yistetamu mealma, veyive bar nash milla dechachmeta, vela yishkach man deyema, vetaan kol alma beorayyta, begin dela yishtekach benayyhu, man deittear bechachmeta. al hahu zimna ketiv, veim kol adat yisrael yishgu. veim yishgu beorayyta, vela yindeun orchaha, bemay hu, begin venellam davar meene hakkahal, dela yishtekach man deyada legallaa amikta deorayyta veorchaha. vavy leinnun darin demishtakkeche keden bealma.

Amar ribbi yehuda, zammin kudesha berich hu legallaa razin amikin deorayyta, bezimna demalka meshicha, begin (Yeshayahu 11:9) demala haaretz dea et Adonai kammayim layyam mechassim. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:34) velo yelammedu od ish et reehu veish et achiv lemor deu et Adonai ki chulam yedu oti lemikketannam vead gedolam amen ken yehi ratzon.

(Vayikra 4:22) asher nasi yechota veasa achat vegomer bishgaga veashem. tane ribbi yitzchak, may shena bechol atar dichtiv behu veim, kema deat amer im hakkohen hammashiach yechota. veim kol adat yisrael yishgu, vehacha asher nasi yechota, vela ketiv vim nasi yecheta, may ka mayyre.

Ella, illen kahanaya la mishtakkeche hachi bechattaa, deha kohen natir garmeh tedira, begin dematula demareh aleh bechol yoma, umatula deyisrael kullehu, umatula dechol chad vechad, veal da tavvavha ihu kad yechota, uvegin kach veim ketiv. vechen veim kol addat yisrael yishgu, tavvavha hu dechullehu yishtachchu bechova chad, dei illen yechetun, illen la yechetun, uvegine kach veim ketiv. aval hacha asher nasi yechota, vadday, begin delibbeh gas beh, veamma azlin avatreh, veitmenun techotoy. veal da asher nasi yechota. kegon deavar al mitzvot lo taase, vehu avid chad minnayyhu, veal da la ketiv beh veim, deha milloy la besifka havo.

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Shemot 35:27) vehannesiim heviu et avni hassoham veet avne hammilluim laefod velachoshen. may shena demillin illen akrivu nesiim, vela bar nash ochora, veha ketiv (Shemot 35:5) kol nediv libbo yevieha et terumat Adonai, uchetiv (Shemot 35:9) veavne soham veavni milluim laefod velachoshen.

Ella, amar kudesha berich hu, af al gav divcholla talya hay nedava, seliku illen avanim lannesiim. may tama, begin deal libba dechahana ishtechachu. amar kudesha berich hu, letu nesiim delibbayyhu gas behu, veyetun illen avanim deinnun mishtakkeche al libba dechahana, veyitkapper alayyhu miggasut libbayyhu, uchetiv (Shemot 28:30) vehayu al lev aharon bevoo lifne Adonai, veal da vehannesiim heviu et avne hashshoham veet avne hammilluim lechappera alayyhu.

Uvegin kach asher nasi yecheta vadday. veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav asher lo teasenna, kema deukemuha, deavar al mitzvat lo taase. o hoda elav chattato. divgin delibbeh gas beh, la ashgach bachataeh, ulevatar ityeyda leh, veavid minneh teshuva.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose havo yatve chad lelya, velaan beorayyta. amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yose, chamena detzachuta deorayyta belelya, hu yattir mibbimama, amay. amar leh, begin detzachuta detora shebbichtav, tora shebbeal pe hu. vetora shebbeal pe, belelya shalta veatarat yattir mibbimama, uvezimna deihi shalta, keden ihu tzachuta deorayyta.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Iyov 35:10) velo amar ayye eloah osay noten zemirot ballayla. ta chazi, (338 lecha 171 amud bet) beshaata deittear ruach tzafon, veitpelag lelya, ha ukemuha, deshalhova chad nafik, uvatash techot gadpoy detarnegola, veakish gadpoy vekare. vehahu shalhova bezimna demate gabbeh, veittear lokovleh, istache beh, veizdaza vekare, veisteche veashgach begin yekara demareh, lemebad reuteh, vkaari lon livne nasha.
Val da ikre sechvi, ashgacha. veikre gever, begin deittear beshalhova
1079: Digvura, besitra digvura ka atya leitteara bealma. keden innun bene mehemnuta kayymin, veyahavin gevura vechela lichneset yisrael, ucheden ikre rinna deorayyta. veal da, yarit david malchuta hu uvenoy lealmin uledare darin.

Vchad tarnegola kare, uvene nasha nayyme bearsayyhu, vela mitare. tarnegola kari levatar, veamar ma deamar, (171 amud bet) veha ukemuha. levatar batash begadpoy, veamar, vavy liflanyya nazif demareh, shavka demareh, dela ittear rucheh, vela ashgach likara demareh.

Kad nahir yemama, karoza kare aleh veamar, velo amar ayye eloah osay noten zemirot ballayla, lesayyeya leh beinnun tushebchan, ulemeheve kolla besiua chada. osay, osani mibbae leh, mahu osay. ella, beshaata debar nash kam befalgut lelya, veishtedal berinna deorayyta, derinna deorayyta la itkere, ella belelya. vechad ihu ishtechach beorayyta, kad nahir yemama, kudesha berich hu uchenset yisrael metakkene leh bechad chuta dechesed leishtezava mikkolla ulenahara leh ben illain vtattain.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ana shemana deamar ribbi abba hay kera, ayye eloah osay, ose li mibbae leh, mahu osay. ella kema deamart, beshaata deihu kam befalgut lelya, veishtedal beorayyta, kad nahar yemama, ittear avraham behahu chuta dileh, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 14:23) im michut vad seroch naal vegomer. vekudesha berich hu uchenset yisrael metakkene leh, veavde leh bechol yoma birya chadasha, hada hu dichtiv eloah osay.

Vha (lecha lecha 94 amud alef) ukemuha, 31 11. 31: da avraham. dichtiv, beh, hael haggadol. 6 da kudesha berich hu. Adonai da keneset yisrael. veda hu eloah. veinnun avdin leh lebar nash, umetakkenin leh bechol yoma, uvegin kach ketiv, osay, kema deat amer (Tehillim 149:2) yismach yisrael beosav. amar ribbi yose, vday kach hu, vecholla chad milla.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, o hoda elav chattato asher chata. hoda elav, missitra deman, o yada (nusach acher noda) chattato mibbae leh, mahu hoda elav. ella kudesha berich hu pakid lichneset yisrael, leodaa leh levar nash, hahu chova dehu chav, uvamma muda leh, bedinaha. kema deat amer (Iyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. hoda elav, keman defakid leochora.

Detaninan beshaata debar nash chav kame kudesha berich hu, vela ashgach bachataeh leahadra betiyyuveta kame mareh, vashde leh batar kitfeh, nishmateh mammash salkat veashidat kame kudesha berich hu. keden, pakid malka lichneset yisrael, veamar o hoda elav chattato asher chata, oshit dina aleh, veoda leh choveh, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 16:2) hoda et yerushala 40 et toavoteha.

Batar demate aleh dina, keden ittear rucha lemehadar betiyyuveta kame mareh, veitkanna lemikrav karbena, deha man delibbeh gas beh, chate, veanshe chataeh, vela ashgach aleh, vekudesha berich hu zammin lokovleh, ufakid leodaa leh lehahu chova, begin dela yitneshe minneh.

Amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vday (sefer acher menalan dehachi) vehachi ashkachna bedavid, dechevan deavad hahu ovada devat sheva, la ashgach beh. amar leh kudesha berich hu, at anshit leh, ana adkarna lach. miyyad ma ketiv, (Shmuel 2 12:7) atta haish ko amar Adonai, atta haish dela dacharit leh, atta haish deanshit leh, uvemma oda leh bedina.

Uf hacha, kudesha berich hu kaamar, hoda elav chattato asher chata veshappir milla, vehachi hu, dela ketiv o noda elav, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 21:36) o noda ki shor naggach hu, uman dekaim belelya lemile beorayyta, orayyta ka moda leh choveh, vela beorach dina ella keimma deodaa livrah, bemilla rachich, vehu la anshe leh, vetav betiyyuveta kame mareh.
